jobs.title: Senior Director, Corporate Counsel
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. 

 About 1Password 
 At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. 

 If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. 

 As Senior Director, Corporate Counsel, you’ll oversee 1Password’s Corporate Legal function and provide strategic legal guidance across a broad range of matters. Reporting to the VP, Legal & General Counsel, you’ll play a key role in supporting 1Password’s growth, M&A activity, international expansion, financing activities and corporate and subsidiary governance. This role also oversees compliance, equity, litigation, intellectual property and marketing matters.

 You’ll partner closely with leaders across Finance, Marketing, People, Corporate Development and other business functions. This role requires a pragmatic, business-minded lawyer who can operate effectively in a fast-paced environment, manage complex projects, and provide clear advice on matters involving multiple stakeholders and jurisdictions.

 This is a remote opportunity within the United States and Canada.

 How we’re using AI today 
 On the Legal team, AI helps us move faster without sacrificing quality. We use it to draft and review commercial agreements, implement negotiation playbooks, and prepare the groundwork for legal review. AI also helps us stay on top of regulatory developments, synthesize research across jurisdictions, and identify risks in novel situations like new product launches or partnership structures. The result is a team that can operate at higher volume with greater consistency, while creating more time for the judgment calls, collaboration, and meaningful decisions that matter most.

 What we're looking for: 
 Juris Doctor with active bar membership in Canada or the United States and at least 10 years of relevant experience, including time at a nationally recognized law firm and ideally a mix of late-stage private and public company work. Experience in technology or SaaS is preferred.

 Experience leading or supporting mergers and acquisitions, including due diligence, negotiations, transaction documentation, and post-closing integration.

 Strong knowledge of corporate governance, securities laws, entity management and experience preparing for or managing public company compliance.

 Experience advising on international expansion, including subsidiary formation and regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions.

 Experience supporting financing transactions and related securities law compliance.

 Ability to identify legal and business risks, develop practical mitigation strategies, and communicate recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.

 Experience managing external counsel and coordinating cross-functional teams on complex legal matters.

 Excellent judgment, written and verbal communication skills, and attention to detail.

 A practical, collaborative, and solutions-oriented approach to legal work.

 Ability to manage competing priorities independently while maintaining a high standard of execution.

 What you can expect: 
 Lead the legal workstreams for mergers and acquisitions, including due diligence, negotiations, drafting and reviewing transaction documents, and coordinating with external advisors and internal stakeholders.

 Advise on legal considerations and regulatory requirements related to international operations and expansion.

 Oversee corporate entities, corporate records, and related governance processes, including the incorporation and ongoing management of global subsidiaries

 Provide guidance on corporate governance matters, including developing and implementing corporate policies and procedures.

 Support Finance on a variety of matters, including insurance renewals, tax planning, financial statements, employee equity, commission plans, and other strategic projects.

 Review marketing materials and advise on applicable compliance requirements.

 Develop and deliver compliance training programs for employees on relevant legal and regulatory topics.

 Identify legal risks across the organization and develop strategies to mitigate those risks.

 Manage litigation and dispute resolution matters, including overseeing external counsel, developing case strategies, and supporting negotiations.

 Manage 1Password’s intellectual property portfolio, including trademarks, copyrights, and patents.

 Serve as a trusted legal partner to leaders across the business, balancing thoughtful risk management with the needs of a fast-moving company.

 USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $269,000 USD and $404,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

 Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $234,000 CAD and $351,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

 This posting is for an existing vacancy. 

 Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

 How we work with AI 
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

 This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

 Our approach to remote work 
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

 What we offer 
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

 Health and wellbeing 
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future 
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

 Community 
🤝 Paid volunteer days 
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
 *Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

 Reporting to the Senior Director of Product, the Director of Product, AI Growth grows 1Password's new business in artificial intelligence. In this role, you own driving growth for our AI opportunities by identifying which customers we target, which outcomes we win on, and proving it with design customers. You scale growth through our go-to-market organization and through partnerships with the agent ecosystem and channel partners.

 How we’re using AI today 
 Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

 This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

 What we're looking for: 
 Minimum of 8 years of product management experience, including experience carrying a revenue or adoption target, with a preference for experience in security products, agentic products, or developer tools.

 Experience owning the strategy for a new product area or market entry, and taking it from hypothesis to customers running in production.

 Experience working directly with enterprise customers on a technical deployment, as the person accountable for the outcome, and turning what those deployments proved into a repeatable motion a sales team can run.

 Experience building technology partnerships and integrations, including judging where a product should sit in a larger technology ecosystem and working with business development on commercial terms.

 Technical depth to hold a credible conversation with developers and security architects about how AI agents are built, deployed, and given access to systems.

 Demonstrated ability to build alignment across go-to-market and engineering teams toward a shared goal, without direct authority over either.

 Demonstrated ability to make decisions and move work forward with incomplete information in a fast-changing market.

 Takes ownership end to end, including the work that falls between teams.

 Works AI-first: uses agents in daily work, and applies their own judgement to decisions, product taste, and customer and internal relationships.

 Preferred: familiarity with agentic access products, meaning the products that give AI agents credentials and access to the systems they work in.

 What you can expect: 

 Growth strategy
 Own the growth thesis for 1Password's AI opportunities, covering the customer segments we target, the outcomes we deliver that we win on, and the workflows we get embedded into. Revise it as evidence arrives from customers, partners, and the market.

 Form and test hypotheses using customer feedback, product usage data, partner input, and market research gathered with the go-to-market, product, user experience, and product marketing teams.

 Lead a weekly business review that brings the voice of the customer, field feedback, and product usage telemetry into one view, so the team can refine targets, forecast the roadmap's impact on growth, and prioritize the blockers that hold adoption back.

 Identify what stops customers from adopting, and drive each blocker to a resolution with the product team that owns it.

 Design customer program
 Run the design customer program for new artificial intelligence opportunities, from selecting customers through to delivered outcomes.

 Act as the general contractor for each design customer: the single person accountable for getting that customer deployed on 1Password for their agentic access, and for delivering the security and convenience outcomes they came for. Coordinate every team the deployment touches, and build what it requires together with a forward deployed engineering team.

 Bring in solutions engineering, customer success, and product managers to help each customer reach their goal, and run feature betas with the product managers who own those features.

 Turn what the program proves into the repeatable signal the company needs to scale, meaning the customer evidence, the deployment pattern, and the measured outcomes that the go-to-market and channel teams build sales plays on.

 Improve the program each cycle so it reaches more design customers, raises delivery success rates and customer satisfaction, and shortens the time it takes the company to commercialize a new product.

 Partnerships
 Decide where 1Password should play in the customer's artificial intelligence stack to deliver the most customer value in securing agent access. Agent access can be controlled at several points in that stack, so weigh those points and choose the ones that solve the most of the customer's problem, rather than the ones we fit into most easily. Base the call on how customers run AI today and on how the industry is evolving.

 Identify and pursue the partnerships that let us play at those points and that complete an end-to-end customer outcome, meaning the outcome a customer cannot reach with 1Password alone.

 Work with partners to deliver integrations, and find the patterns that let us repeat an integration across similar partners instead of building each one from scratch.

 Work with the business development team to structure commercial relationships that grow both companies' business and deliver value to shared customers.

 Scale through the field and the developer community
 Work with product enablement to build demos and enablement content that the field and our channel partners can use without your involvement.

 Work with developer relations to grow adoption organically among developers, through reference architectures, sample code, and open source contributions.

 Travel
 Travel to design customer sites, partner meetings, and industry events approximately 10 to 20% of a given year.

Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. 

 As Senior Director, Global Total Rewards, you’ll lead the strategy and delivery of compensation, equity, benefits, and related programs across a global technology organization. You’ll guide an approximately eight-person team, partner with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, and help build scalable, equitable programs that support 1Password’s mission to make it safe for everyone to access the information they need. 

 How we’re using AI today 
On the People team, we’re using AI intentionally and responsibly as part of how our work gets done. We’re building a shared foundation of AI confidence and capability with the belief that innovation happens best when we learn and experiment together. From drafting communications and synthesizing feedback to automating workflows across the employee lifecycle, we’re embedding AI into our day-to-day operations and the way we collaborate cross-functionally, helping us move quickly and create space for the human moments that matter most.

 This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

 What we're looking for: 
 • Extensive senior-level experience leading global Total Rewards programs, including compensation, equity, benefits, retirement, and executive compensation.
 • Experience guiding Total Rewards strategy and operations through significant organizational growth, evolving governance requirements, or preparation for an initial public offering (IPO) and public-company operations.
 • Strong experience advising executives, Compensation Committees, and Boards, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations and decisions.

Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

 How we work with AI 
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

 This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

 Our approach to work 
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. 

 What we offer 
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

 Health and wellbeing 
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future 
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

 Community 
🤝 Paid volunteer days 
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
 *Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting. 

 You belong here. 

 1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love. 

 Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs. 

 Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you. 

 Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

jobs.title: Data Center Capacity Delivery, Canada
jobs.description:
About Anthropic 

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

 About the role 

 As a Senior Data Center Capacity Delivery Manager at Anthropic, you'll embed with project teams responsible for delivery of leased and partnered data center capacity. Your primary role will be to lead these partners to deliver on the fastest possible schedule while maintaining a safe construction site and protecting the finished quality of the data center.

 Additionally, you'll validate deal readiness, coordinate complex stakeholder relationships, maintain regular reporting and status tracking, and ensure seamless transitions from project inception through operational readiness. 

 This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Anthropic secures and activates the compute infrastructure needed to train and deploy frontier AI systems, working at the intersection of real estate, construction, and cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

 Responsibilities 

 Lead. This is a role where leadership trumps management and process. You will be at one or more project sites 60% of the time or more and expected to shape the culture, approach, and aggressiveness that define those extended site teams. The goal is to impact outcomes in a favorable manner.

 You are expected to be a force multiplier that develops and enhances the skillset that development partners, general contractors, and key trades bring to the project(s) you are overseeing. That means being a subject matter expert in the various cross functional elements of data center delivery and increasing the team's performance with that knowledge and commitment to alignment.

 Confirm deal readiness and serve as the gatekeeper to validate transaction viability from Letter of Intent (LOI) through lease execution, ensuring all predevelopment, planning, technical and business requirements are met before commitment

 Partner with landlords and developers post-deal to serve as Anthropic's primary point of contact, coordinating across internal stakeholders, tracking construction progress, and facilitating critical information exchange between development partners and Anthropic stakeholders

 Represent Anthropic in key technical and operational decisions required by partners during the development process, ensuring our infrastructure requirements are met while maintaining strong partnerships

 Drive seamless handoffs to operational state with heavy focus on engagement across networking and deployment teams, enabling rapid workload turn-ups and minimizing time-to-production

 Prepare and present regular executive reporting on progress versus plan for facility development, supporting forward capacity planning and strategic decision-making

 Identify and mitigate risks throughout the delivery lifecycle, proactively addressing blockers that could impact timeline, cost, or technical requirements

 Develop and refine standardized processes and playbooks for facility delivery, driving continuous improvement as Anthropic scales its infrastructure footprint

 You may be a good fit if you 

 Have 10+ years of experience in the highest level of site leadership managing data center delivery, construction projects, or infrastructure deployment at scale.  You won’t have a big direct team to delegate too but will instead be able to treat the entire cross functional organizations at a jobsite as your team.

 Have a strong understanding of the end to end (dirt to delivery) data center development process to include entitlements and permitting, planning and supply chain, execution, commissioning, and handover. You are not an administrator but an active player in the arena comfortable making decisions and guiding delivery execution without the need to consult across multiple external parties.

 You should understand data center design and construction as a simple and repeatable process that allows you to build and optimize delivery without a playbook and with minimal processes and tools handed to you.  If you can think about building a data center the way kids might build a tree fort or construct a lego set, we want to talk.

 In this role you will often be on an island and responsible for your own destiny. You will have free reign to develop your own approaches with the mission guidance being your only bounds. No one will be there to empower your efforts; you will create your own influence by building relationships at the site and diving in at all phases to deliver success.

 You must thrive operating with ambiguity and have a willingness to own project outcomes, knowing that the buck stops with you.

 In this role, it is imperative that you are as comfortable in boots on a job site working to solve productivity issues with a group of blue collar trades as you are working across executives at development and contractor partners to optimize contract and commercial structures that incentivize delivery speed.

 It's a bonus if you 

 Understand AI/ML infrastructure requirements, including high-density power and advanced cooling systems

 Have had leadership positions (General Superintendent, Project Manager) within a GC or EPC on hyperscale data center projects or in self performance of hyperscale data center development projects.

 Prioritize extreme ownership and have the ability to create winning cultures across diverse job sites.

 Are deeply familiar with lease negotiations, construction contracts, or real estate development processes and have strategies to move those arrangements from traditionally transaction and risk managed arrangements to collaborative efforts that align incentives around accelerated delivery of facilities

 Logistics 

 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

 For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings.

 How we're different 

 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

 Come work with us! 

 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:  Learn about  our policy for using AI in our application process.

Leveraging digital tools, AI, and data-driven insights to accelerate concept development, testing, and portfolio decision-making

jobs.title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
Chief of Staff - Executive Leadership Program
jobs.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

 Chief of Staff, Executive Leadership Program 

 Banyan Software  |  Two-year program  |  Remote: United States or Canada  |  Start date: Summer 2027  |  Open to final-year MBA candidates

 Timelines:  -Select on-campus & virtual campus events: Oct/Nov 2026;   -Interviews starting Jan 2027;   -Offers: Feb 2027   -Start date: May/June 2027

 The Opportunity 

 This is a high-impact opportunity to work directly alongside one of Banyan’s seasoned Operating Leaders, each overseeing a portfolio of software businesses in a buy, hold and grow investment model. As Chief of Staff, you become a trusted right hand to your Operating Leader and a close working partner to the CEOs and functional leaders across their companies.

 The role is deliberately broad. Rather than a fixed rotation, you will move across multiple operating companies and business problems: shaping a go-to-market plan for one company, improving customer onboarding at another, or standing up the first 100 days of a newly acquired business. You will gain exposure to software M&A, but the core of the job is hands-on value creation and operating work. You own initiatives end to end.

 The Executive Leadership Program (ELP) runs two years. Development is intentional. You will work through a range of experiences spanning go-to-market, M&A, customer, and finance priorities portfolio-wide, plus gain hands-on leadership reps, with regular check-ins and development opportunities to ready you for your next role. High performers move from the ELP program into a CEO or C-suite role within a Banyan operating company, or into a leadership role at Banyan Software HQ.

 For those who want to learn how great vertical software businesses are built and run, and who want the fastest path available to running one themselves, this is the job.

 What You’ll Gain 

 A cohort of high-caliber peers. You grow and learn alongside other ELPs at Banyan, building a long-term network of future operators.

 Direct apprenticeship with senior operators. You will work very closely with an Operating Leader and see firsthand how experienced leaders make decisions across different software businesses.

 Dedicated development support. External executive coaching in Year 2, plus mentorship from Operating Leaders with decades of software experience.

 The fastest track we offer to running a business. High performers move directly from this program into a C-suite seat inside a Banyan operating company or a leadership role at HQ. It is not guaranteed, performance decides placement, but it is the first place Banyan looks when those seats open and we have a strong track record of placing CEOs through our ELP.

 Real operating reps, not case reps. You carry a genuine initiative inside a live business and leadership-level stretch assignments, decisions that show up in a P&L.

 What You Will Own 

 Portfolio Value Creation 

 Partner with CEOs and functional leaders across multiple operating companies to identify priorities and implement the Banyan Operating System, turning strategy into measurable operational improvements.

 Lead high-impact, cross-functional projects across product, go-to-market, sales, marketing, pricing, and customer success as the right hand to Leader.

 M&A and Integration 

 Gain exposure to Banyan’s acquisition process, including value-creation plan framing during diligence.

 Support integration planning and onboarding for newly acquired businesses, helping establish operating rhythms and priorities while respecting what already makes each business work.

 Help execute the value-creation plan once a deal closes, turning the diligence thesis into the specific operating bets a business needs to win in year one.

 Executive Partnership 

 Support your Operating Leader on critical initiatives, executive decision-making, and cross-company collaboration, frequently influencing outcomes without formal authority or direct reports.

 Build the judgment, breadth, and pattern recognition required for future general management by working different business problems across a portfolio of vertical software companies.

 What We’re Looking For 

 Must-Haves 

 Graduating or recently graduated from a top MBA program. This cycle is not open to first-year MBA students.

 2–5 years of pre-MBA experience in an operating role (product, business operations, portfolio operations, or value creation), management consulting, private equity, or investment banking, with a demonstrated record of owning measurable outcomes.

 Exceptional communication and interpersonal judgment, with the ability to synthesize complex information and influence senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

 High learning agility and comfort with ambiguity. You get smart quickly in unfamiliar areas, prioritize what matters, and move from analysis to action.

 Low ego and high ownership. You are ambitious but humble, seek feedback, build trust quickly, and are motivated by the work of operating a business rather than by title.

 US or Canadian work authorization is required.

 Nice-to-Haves 

 Experience in software, SaaS, or another recurring revenue business. Familiarity with vertical software economics is an advantage.

 Experience leading a team. Direct people management is not required; this role initially relies on leadership through influence.

 Banyan is an equal opportunity employer. 
 Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Equal Employment Opportunity at Banyan: Banyan affirms that inequality is detrimental to our Global Teams, associates, our Operating Companies, and the communities we serve. As a collective, our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions. Together, we unite for equality and equity. Banyan is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic, including race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, or protected veteran status and will not discriminate against anyone on the basis of a disability. We support an inclusive workplace where associates excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance.

 Please Note: Banyan Software does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications submitted via email, LinkedIn, or other direct channels. All candidates must apply through our official Careers site to be considered for employment. Applications submitted outside of our applicant tracking system will not be reviewed.

 Recruitment Notice 

 Banyan Software may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

  

 Beware of Recruitment Scams 

 We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment. 

 Protect yourself by following these steps: 

 Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware.com email address.

 Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process.

 If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

 Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

 You will be based in Toronto, with access to Banyan's corporate functions. You will not build or manage a team of direct reports within the Foundation at first. You are its sole strategic owner, personally accountable for its frameworks, its grantee relationships, and its voice. You are not an island, though, and you are not expected to execute everything alone.

 Our culture is entrepreneurial and decentralized, spanning more than 100 operating companies. Part of the mandate is to make the Foundation's mission real inside that culture: mobilizing employees and portfolio company leadership around it, not just administering grants from a distance.  Why Banyan 

 A $100 million mandate, not a pilot: the Foundation is endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock. This is permanent capital behind a permanent commitment.

 Real ownership: you are the strategic owner of the Foundation function, accountable for its direction, its programs, and its voice, without having to build or manage a Foundation team from scratch.

 Set direction with real autonomy in early, ambiguous conditions, rather than executing a pre-set plan.

 Build trust and credibility with Banyan employees, portfolio company leaders, grantees, and external partners.

 Represent the Foundation in high-visibility settings, including Banyan's Global Leadership Conference.

 Develop and deliver the narrative that captures the Foundation's mission and its measurable impact.

 Apply technology and AI tools where they meaningfully advance program design, measurement, or the Foundation's internal reach.

 Experience embedding a mission-driven or purpose-led initiative within a broader organization and mobilizing others around it, ideally within a decentralized or entrepreneurial structure.

 Banyan Software acquires vertical market software companies and holds them for the long term. You'll be the builder of an AI-native global people operations engine, including HR and TA systems, workflows, compensation processes, data, and analytics.

  

 A key early priority will be running the workstream to select and implement a modern, AI-enabled global HR system that connects into Banyan's broader enterprise data and technology platform. You'll partner across HR, Finance, IT, Legal, and the broader business to build the infrastructure, insights, and intelligent processes that enable better decisions and sustained growth.

 People Processes & Workflows: Own the end-to-end design and delivery of core people processes across the employee lifecycle: hiring, onboarding, transitions, offboarding, transactions, and employee service. Build, ship, iterate. Drive efficiency through standardization and automation.

 HR Operational Engine for HRBPs: Own the infrastructure that enables our decentralized HRBP model — HRIS configuration and governance, people services workflows, policy and framework documentation, and the tools HRBPs rely on to support portfolio companies.

 Compensation Programs & Governance: Run global compensation programs and annual cycles. Own job architecture, leveling, benchmarking, and pay equity analysis. Build and maintain the decision frameworks that keep comp questions from escalating unnecessarily.

 Benefits Execution Infrastructure: Own the systems, processes, and operational workflows that support benefits delivery globally. You are the operational partner ensuring benefits infrastructure runs cleanly and integrates with HR systems as we grow.

 HR Policies & Global Employment Compliance: Own Banyan's people policies and global employment compliance posture. Partner with Legal on employment law, employee data privacy, and jurisdictional requirements. Keep the handbook current and consistent.

 Hands-on Automation & Workflow Build: Identify high-value AI and automation use cases across talent acquisition, onboarding, employee service, and comp cycles. Evaluate tools, configure them, ship the workflows, and measure impact.

 People Analytics & Reporting: Build the global analytics capability. Define key metrics, ship dashboards, and generate predictive insights on attrition, hiring, comp, and engagement. Connect people data into the broader enterprise data platform.

 Team Leadership: Build and lead a high-performing global team. Set priorities, establish operating rhythms, and hold a high bar for execution.

 Hands-on People Operations builder. 8–12 years across People Ops or HR Operations in global organizations. You've personally built and shipped HRIS implementations, comp programs, analytics dashboards, and workflows.

 The Opportunity

We are looking for a Director, Legal to join our Toronto team and take ownership of deal execution across the full acquisition lifecycle. jobs.title: VP Sales & Marketing (Bilingual Eng/Fre)
jobs.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

 VP Sales & Marketing (Bilingual Eng/Fre) 

 Reports to: CEO, NovoLogik
 Location: Saint-Jérôme, Quebec, Canada
 Work model: Hybrid-flexible

 About NovoLogik

 NovoLogik provides electronic medical record and practice management software for orthodontic and dental clinics. Its OrthoNovo and DentoNovo platforms bring patient engagement, scheduling, billing, documentation, and imaging together into a single system of record that clinical teams use every day. NovoLogik has been the leading technology provider for orthodontic practices in Quebec for over 20 years, and it is extending that position into new markets across Canada.

 The Opportunity

 NovoLogik has never had a dedicated sales and marketing function. This role exists to build it, starting from a blank page rather than a broken process.

 NovoLogik holds a leading position in its core Quebec orthodontic market and has built a growing, loyal base of dental customers, with high retention and an expanding product set. There is real room to grow, both within existing customer relationships and in new markets across Canada, though building on that position requires a true commercial function, which does not exist today.

 This is a high-volume, relationship-driven commercial motion, not an enterprise field-sales role. Success looks like a functioning CRM, a real marketing engine, a handful of well-chosen industry conferences, new outbound campaigns, and disciplined follow-through on renewals and account growth.

 Because NovoLogik is a small, lean organization, this role also carries general operational and administrative responsibility beyond the commercial mandate. You will partner directly with NovoLogik’s CEO on commercial strategy and priorities.

 Why NovoLogik

 You’re building, not maintaining. This is NovoLogik’s first dedicated sales and marketing leadership hire. Process, tooling, team structure, and positioning are yours to define.

 Real ownership from day one. You are not inheriting a team or a process. You decide what to build first and how, with full accountability for the outcome.

 A business built to grow. NovoLogik holds a leading position in its core market and a sticky, system-of-record product used daily by clinical teams. The growth opportunity in front of you is real.

 A permanent home, not a flip. Banyan acquires and holds its companies indefinitely. You are building something meant to last, not preparing a company for a near-term sale.

 Meaningful scope, fast. In a small, lean organization, your decisions are visible and consequential from day one.

 Direct executive access. You will work closely with NovoLogik’s CEO and with Banyan’s Operating Group on commercial strategy, marketing investment, and growth support.

 What You Will Own

 Go-to-Market Build

 Select and implement a CRM, and establish the sales operating rhythm that goes with it.

 Define and prioritize the ideal customer profile and target segments, starting with the existing customer base.

 Build out marketing collateral, refresh the website in partnership with Banyan’s marketing team, and launch initial outbound campaigns, including SEO and SEM.

 Sales Execution

 Run the full sales cycle: qualify inbound leads, deliver demos, negotiate, and close.

 Own the revenue number from day one as an individual contributor until the team justifies its first hire.

 Build day-to-day sales process and reporting discipline to support the function’s growth.

 Customer & Market Expansion

 Shape product packaging and account-growth opportunities across the existing customer base, in partnership with NovoLogik and Banyan leadership.

 Represent NovoLogik at relevant industry conferences and build a cadence of customer visits, including in English-speaking parts of Canada.

 Build the commercial foundation to extend NovoLogik’s presence beyond Quebec.

 Team Building

 Build the business case for NovoLogik’s first account executive hire as pipeline volume warrants it, in partnership with Banyan.

 Hire, ramp, and mentor new sales talent as the function grows beyond a single seat.

 Operational Leadership

 Take on general operational and administrative responsibilities as needed in a lean organization.

 Identify and drive opportunities to professionalize processes across the business.

 Cross-Functional Partnership

 Work directly with NovoLogik’s CEO on sales strategy and go-to-market execution.

 Partner with Banyan’s Operating Group on go-to-market resourcing, marketing support, and growth priorities.

 What We’re Looking For

 Must-Haves

 Proven, quota-carrying B2B sales experience with a track record of consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets.

 Professionally proficient in both English and French, spoken and written, sufficient to lead business conversations in either language.

 Demonstrated experience building or scaling a sales and marketing function, including process, tooling, and early execution, not purely analytical or advisory work.

 Comfort owning the entire sales cycle (qualifying inbound leads, running demos, negotiating, closing) without an existing SDR team or outbound infrastructure.

 Able to work on-site in Saint-Jérôme, Quebec on a regular basis.

 Comfort operating as a generalist in a small, lean organization, including administrative and operational responsibilities outside the core commercial mandate.

 Nice-to-Haves

 MBA.

 Experience selling into healthcare, dental, or another regulated or professional-services vertical.

 Experience building volume-driven sales or marketing motions rather than closing a small number of large, bespoke deals.

 Working marketing fluency (SEO/SEM, website strategy, campaign management) to help stand up NovoLogik’s first demand-generation motion.

 Experience selling on-premise or hybrid-deployment software rather than pure cloud/SaaS.

 Vice-président(e), Ventes et Marketing (bilingue anglais/français) 

 Relève de: PDG, NovoLogik
 Lieu: Saint-Jérôme, Québec, Canada
 Mode de travail: Hybride flexible

 À propos de NovoLogik

 NovoLogik propose des logiciels de dossiers médicaux électroniques et de gestion de cabinet pour les cliniques dentaires et orthodontiques. Ses plateformes OrthoNovo et DentoNovo réunissent en un seul système de référence l’engagement des patients, la prise de rendez-vous, la facturation, la documentation et l’imagerie, utilisés quotidiennement par les équipes cliniques. Depuis plus de 20 ans, NovoLogik est le principal fournisseur technologique pour les cliniques d’orthodontie au Québec, et étend maintenant cette position à de nouveaux marchés partout au Canada.

 Le Défi

 NovoLogik n’a jamais eu de fonction dédiée aux ventes et au marketing. Ce poste consiste à la bâtir à partir de zéro, plutôt qu’à corriger un processus déjà en place.

 NovoLogik occupe une position de leader dans son marché orthodontique de base au Québec et a développé une clientèle dentaire fidèle et croissante, avec un taux de rétention élevé et une offre de produits en expansion. Il existe un réel potentiel de croissance, tant auprès de la clientèle existante que dans de nouveaux marchés à travers le Canada, mais pour en tirer parti, une véritable fonction commerciale doit être mise en place, ce qui n’existe pas encore aujourd’hui.

 Il s’agit d’une approche commerciale à haut volume et axée sur les relations, et non d’un rôle de vente terrain de type entreprise. La réussite se traduit par un CRM fonctionnel, un véritable moteur marketing, quelques conférences industrielles bien choisies, de nouvelles campagnes de prospection et une discipline rigoureuse dans le suivi des renouvellements et de la croissance des comptes.

 NovoLogik étant une organisation petite et agile, ce rôle comporte également des responsabilités opérationnelles et administratives générales, au-delà du mandat commercial. Vous travaillerez directement avec le PDG de NovoLogik sur la stratégie commerciale et les priorités.

 Pourquoi NovoLogik

 Vous bâtissez, vous ne maintenez pas. Il s’agit du tout premier poste de direction en ventes et marketing chez NovoLogik. Les processus, les outils, la structure d’équipe et le positionnement sont entièrement à définir.

 Une réelle prise en charge dès le premier jour. Vous n’héritez ni d’une équipe ni d’un processus. Vous décidez quoi bâtir en premier et comment, avec une pleine imputabilité des résultats.

 Une entreprise bâtie pour croître. NovoLogik occupe une position de leader dans son marché de base et possède un produit de référence, intégré au quotidien par les équipes cliniques. Le potentiel de croissance devant vous est bien réel.

 Un foyer permanent, pas une revente rapide. Banyan acquiert ses entreprises pour les conserver indéfiniment. Vous bâtissez quelque chose destiné à durer, et non à préparer une entreprise pour une vente à court terme.

 Une portée significative, rapidement. Dans une organisation petite et agile, vos décisions sont visibles et ont un impact dès le premier jour.

 Un accès direct à la direction. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec le PDG de NovoLogik et avec le groupe des opérations de Banyan sur la stratégie commerciale, les investissements marketing et le soutien à la croissance.

 Ce Que Vous Prendrez en Charge

 Mise en place de la stratégie de mise en marché

 Sélectionner et déployer un CRM, et établir la cadence opérationnelle des ventes qui l’accompagne.

 Définir et prioriser le profil de client idéal et les segments cibles, en commençant par la clientèle existante.

 Développer du matériel marketing, actualiser le site Web en partenariat avec l’équipe marketing de Banyan, et lancer les premières campagnes de prospection, y compris le référencement (SEO) et la publicité payante (SEM).

 Exécution des ventes

 Gérer l’ensemble du cycle de vente: qualifier les pistes entrantes, effectuer les démonstrations, négocier et conclure.

 Assumer la responsabilité du chiffre d’affaires dès le premier jour, à titre de contributeur individuel, jusqu’à ce que le volume justifie la première embauche.

 Mettre en place les processus de vente et la rigueur de suivi au quotidien pour soutenir la croissance de la fonction.

 Expansion de la clientèle et du marché

 Façonner l’offre de produits et les occasions de croissance de comptes au sein de la clientèle existante, en partenariat avec la direction de NovoLogik et de Banyan.

 Représenter NovoLogik lors de conférences industrielles pertinentes et établir une cadence de visites clients, y compris dans les régions anglophones du Canada.

 Bâtir les fondations commerciales permettant d’étendre la présence de NovoLogik au-delà du Québec.

 Développement de l’équipe

 Bâtir, en partenariat avec Banyan, la justification d’affaires pour la première embauche d’un ou d’une représentant(e) des comptes, selon le volume du pipeline.

 Recruter, intégrer et encadrer de nouveaux talents en vente à mesure que la fonction se développe au-delà d’un seul poste.

 Leadership opérationnel

 Assumer des responsabilités opérationnelles et administratives générales selon les besoins d’une organisation agile.

 Repérer et mener des initiatives de professionnalisation des processus à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

 Collaboration transversale

 Travailler directement avec le PDG de NovoLogik sur la stratégie de vente et l’exécution de la mise en marché.

 Collaborer avec le groupe des opérations de Banyan sur les ressources de mise en marché, le soutien marketing et les priorités de croissance.

jobs.title: Director, AI Technology Delivery
jobs.description:
Application Deadline: 

12/30/2026 

 Address: 
250 Yonge Street 

 Job Family Group:

Data Analytics & Reporting 

 Please note: This is a hybrid role based in Toronto. Candidates outside Ontario would need to relocate to meet the role's in-office requirements.

 About the Role 

 As Director, Technology Delivery Lead, you are accountable for the end-to-end technology delivery of Em, BMO InvestorLine's premier AI agent. You will lead the integrated delivery system across AI engineering, wealth platforms, Microsoft Azure, data, architecture, quality engineering, cybersecurity, operations, and third parties to deliver safe, resilient, scalable, and measurable client outcomes.
 You will operate as the principal technology counterpart to the Product Owner for Em. Together, you are jointly accountable for overall delivery: the Product Owner leads product vision, client value, priorities, and acceptance; the Technology Delivery Lead owns the integrated technology plan, engineering execution, technical quality, production readiness, and predictable delivery. This role is not a program coordination position. It is a hands-on senior technology leadership role with clear decision rights and accountability for outcomes.

 Mandate and Decision Rights 

 Own the integrated technology delivery plan for Em from discovery and architecture through build, evaluation, release, operation, and continuous improvement.
 Jointly commit scope, sequencing, release outcomes, and delivery forecasts with the Product Owner, balancing client value, technical feasibility, risk, cost, and capacity.
 Make or escalate timely technology delivery decisions across architecture, engineering, environments, data, integration, testing, controls, and production readiness.
 Hold delivery teams and partners accountable for agreed outcomes, quality standards, dependencies, and evidence-based release criteria.
 Protect the product from unmanaged technical debt, fragmented ownership, late-stage controls, and delivery practices that are not fit for AI.

 Key Responsibilities 

 1.      End-to-End Technology Delivery 

 Lead delivery across multiple cross-functional product and platform teams, establishing one integrated plan, clear critical path, transparent dependencies, and accountable owners.
 Convert the product roadmap into executable technology increments, release plans, capacity models, milestones, and outcome-based commitments.
 Drive delivery discipline across scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, risk, and benefits, using forecasts rather than artificial certainty.
 Identify constraints early, remove impediments, resolve cross-team trade-offs, and escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations.
 Ensure each release has explicit entry, exit, acceptance, operational readiness, and rollback criteria.

 2. AI Engineering and AI SDLC Leadership 

 Apply deep knowledge of generative AI and agentic systems, including LLM orchestration, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt and context engineering, evaluations, guardrails, memory, and human oversight.
 Embed full-lifecycle AI SDLC practices across requirements, design, build, test, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and model or prompt change management.
 Ensure AI quality is measured using fit-for-purpose evaluations covering safety, groundedness, relevance, accuracy, latency, reliability, and client experience.
 Champion specification-driven development, automation, reusable engineering patterns, and AI-assisted software delivery where approved.
 Ensure deterministic software testing and probabilistic AI evaluation are integrated into CI/CD and release decisions.

 3.      Azure, Architecture and Platform Integration 

 Provide senior technical leadership for solutions deployed on Microsoft Azure and integrated with BMO InvestorLine and Wealth Management platforms.
 Partner with solution, enterprise, security, data, and platform architects to maintain an approved, scalable target architecture and prevent local optimization or avoidable technical debt.
 Ensure APIs, event flows, data services, identity, access, observability, resilience, and non-functional requirements are designed and delivered end to end.
 Drive environment readiness, infrastructure as code, automated deployment, telemetry, performance engineering, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and production support readiness.
 Promote reuse of enterprise AI capabilities, shared services, patterns, and controls while preserving clear service boundaries and ownership.

 4.      Advanced Agile and Value-Stream Delivery 

 Establish and continuously improve an advanced Agile operating model organized around persistent, cross-functional teams and measurable client or business outcomes.
 Lead portfolio and product-level planning, backlog readiness, dependency management, release forecasting, and flow optimization across multiple teams.
 Use evidence-based metrics such as lead time, cycle time, throughput, work in progress, predictability, escaped defects, reliability, evaluation performance, and value realization.
 Reduce handoffs, unnecessary governance, meeting load, and blocked work; create fast decision paths and clear single-point accountability.
 Coach delivery leaders, Scrum Masters, engineering leads, and teams in modern product delivery, DevSecOps, continuous delivery, and learning-driven retrospectives.

 5.      Quality, Risk and Responsible AI 

 Build quality, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, model risk, accessibility, and responsible AI requirements into delivery from inception, not as release-end checkpoints.
 Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Model Risk, Data Governance, and Technology Risk to establish proportionate controls and auditable evidence.
 Ensure full-spectrum observability across application, infrastructure, data, model, prompt, agent, safety, and client-experience performance.
 Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and learning reviews for technology or AI quality events.
 Maintain transparent risk, issue, dependency, and decision records and ensure material risks are escalated promptly.

 Build strong relationships across the organization and with portfolio companies, fostering open communication, collaboration and effective problem-solving to support timely, accurate and decision-useful reporting

jobs.title: Executive Director, Sales Enablement - North America
jobs.description:
Sales Enablement Lead – North America
 Location: Toronto, Canada
 Practice Area: Global Sales | Growth Activation
 Employment Type: Permanent

   

 Shape strategic deals. Strengthen how we sell. Drive growth. 

  

 The Opportunity 

 Capco is looking for a Sales Enablement Lead – North America to play a key role in strengthening sales effectiveness, shaping strategic opportunities and driving growth across our US and Canadian businesses. Working closely with regional leadership and reporting to the Global Sales Enablement Lead, you will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution — supporting high-value pursuits, challenging commercial approaches and delivering practical initiatives that improve how we sell. This is a highly visible, collaborative role for someone who understands how consulting business is won, can engage credibly with senior leaders and has the drive to turn ideas into tangible results.

  

 What You'll Do 

  

 Drive Strategic Pursuits and Improve Win Rates 

 Lead and shape priority pursuits, from opportunity strategy and solution development through proposals, commercial discussions and executive presentations.

 Challenge deal strategies, sharpen differentiation and strengthen client value propositions.

 Bring together the right expertise across Capco to develop compelling, commercially sound solutions.

 Champion exceptional quality across strategic pursuits, establishing clear quality standards and review gates to ensure proposals, solutions and client presentations are compelling, differentiated and commercially robust.

 Facilitate pipeline and deal reviews, win strategy sessions and pitch preparation for major opportunities.

 Capture lessons from wins and losses to improve future deal performance.

   

 Build Sales Capabilities Across Capco 

 Lead and support sales education initiatives that strengthen sales confidence, develop practical selling skills and build growth capabilities across career levels.

 Design and deliver targeted learning, coaching and hands-on development for client-facing teams.

 Strengthen capabilities in opportunity origination, consultative selling, solution shaping, storytelling and strategic account growth.

 Work with regional leaders to identify capability gaps and address them through practical interventions.

 Build commercial confidence and embed effective sales behaviours into everyday client engagement.

   

 Make Selling More Effective 

 Develop practical playbooks, tools and guidance that improve effectiveness across the sales lifecycle.

 Champion AI-enabled sales productivity, identifying opportunities to simplify work, improve quality and reduce duplication.

 Drive the adoption and effective use of knowledge assets and reusable sales content.

 Translate successful sales approaches into repeatable practices that can scale across the business.

 Work with sellers to identify friction points and deliver improvements that make a tangible difference.

   

 Connect Expertise and Unlock Growth 

 Work across accounts, domains and capabilities to identify cross-sell opportunities and shape integrated client propositions.

 Connect regional teams with relevant market insights, expertise and growth initiatives from across Capco.

 Support joint pursuits and go-to-market opportunities with strategic partners, including Wipro.

 Turn successful approaches and lessons learned into opportunities for wider adoption across the firm.

   

 What We're Looking For 

 We are looking for a growth-minded, credible and action-oriented sales professional who understands how consulting business is won and actively collaborates across the leadership team to help Capco succeed. 

 You will bring:

 15+ years of consulting and financial services experience, ideally gained through client-facing consulting, business development, strategic sales or delivery roles.

 Proven experience shaping complex, high-value pursuits, including win strategy, solution development, proposals and senior client presentations.

 Commercial judgement and confidence to challenge senior stakeholders, test assumptions and strengthen deal strategies.

 A strong understanding of financial services, with experience in Banking, Capital Markets, Wealth & Asset Management or Insurance.

 Excellent storytelling and communication skills, translating complex ideas and solutions into compelling client narratives.

 Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to influence senior leaders and mobilize teams across a matrix organization.

 A strategic and analytical mindset, combined with the ability to turn ideas into practical solutions and measurable outcomes.

 A collaborative, entrepreneurial approach, with the confidence to take ownership, challenge constructively and get things done.

 A passion for developing people, sharing knowledge and strengthening the capabilities of the wider organization.

  

 Above all, you are someone who can see the bigger growth picture while staying close to the detail and execution.

  

 Bonus Points For 

 Experience designing or delivering sales capability development, coaching or enablement programs.

 Hands-on experience using Generative AI, GPT technologies or AI agents to improve sales productivity.

 Experience in sales operations, commercial management or sales process improvement.

 Experience developing joint propositions or supporting strategic partner pursuits.

 An established network within North American financial services.

 Experience implementing knowledge management, credentials or sales enablement platforms.

   

 Why Join Capco? 

 Influence growth across North America. Work directly with senior leaders and strategic deal teams to create opportunities, strengthen pursuits and contribute to business growth.

 Shape the future of how Capco sells. Play a leading role in building stronger sales capabilities, embedding effective commercial disciplines and delivering our Capco 30 ambitions.

 Make a tangible difference. This is a role where you will not just recommend improvements - you will shape, build and deliver them.

 Connect the best of Capco. Work across regions, domains, capabilities and strategic partners to bring our collective expertise to clients.

 Be part of an entrepreneurial culture. Join a collaborative, ambitious organization where ideas are valued, initiative is encouraged and individuals can make a visible impact.

 Grow your own career. Gain exposure to senior leadership, complex strategic opportunities and the development of a globally connected sales enablement capability.

  

 The Impact You'll Make 

 Your success will be measured by the difference you make: stronger deals, more confident sellers, better sales practices and greater commercial effectiveness.  You will help Capco win more business today while building the capabilities and disciplines that support sustainable growth tomorrow.

Benefits 

 We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:

 Comprehensive Benefits Coverage: 100% company-paid health, life and disability insurance, effective from Day 1 of employment.

 Retirement Savings Program: Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with the option of receiving a matching employer contribution.

 Virtual Health Care: Company-paid virtual health care program available to all employees and their dependents/partners.

 Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP): Company-paid support services for employees and their dependents/partners.

 Parental Leave Top-Up: Enhanced parental leave benefits available from Day 1 of employment.

 New Parent Gift: A company-sponsored gift to celebrate the arrival of a new child.

 Wellness Support: Fitness reimbursement benefit to promote health and well-being.

 Business Coach from Day 1: Personalized one-on-one coaching to support career growth, accelerate development and help achieve your professional goals at Capco.

   

 Inclusion at Capco 

 We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

  

 Use of Artificial Intelligence in Talent Acquisition 

 At Capco, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support and enhance several parts of talent acquisition. This includes using AI-enabled features within LinkedIn to help source potential candidates, speeding up routine recruitment communications such as emails and creating compelling and brand-aligned job postings that accurately reflect role requirements, and AI-scheduling applications to improve the efficiency of interview coordination.  AI is used as a support tool only. All hiring decisions are made by talent acquisition and hiring teams.

   

 Why This Role Is Open 

 We are currently hiring for this role due to an existing or newly created vacancy within our organization. This position is open as part of our ongoing business needs, and we are actively reviewing applications to fill this role with a qualified candidate who can make an immediate impact.
