jobs.title: Technical VP - AI Data Platform
jobs.description:
Huawei Canada has an immediate permanent opening for a Technical VP. 

 About the team: 
 The Emerging Storage Lab is a research group based at Huawei Canada's Toronto Research Centre that is focused on next-generation data and storage technologies and innovations. Our team comprises graduate computer engineers and computer scientists with diverse industry experience, ranging from 0 to over 20 years. This lab investigates various data storage-related topics, including data management, data catalog, data fabric, file systems, storage networks, and AI storage, aiming to advance the field and drive data storage technological progress in the new AI era. 

 About the job: 
 Define the technology roadmap for next-generation data storage and AI retrieval systems, aligning with global R&D and business objectives. Set the global research agenda for AI Data Platforms, with a specific focus on vector-native data lakes, intelligent caching layers, and high-performance retrieval infrastructures that power Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). 

 Lead the lab’s transition to Data-Centric AI, pioneering research in Agent memory system, Knowledge Base, and RAG-optimized data intelligence systems. Drive innovation in dynamic data indexing, hybrid search (semantic + keyword), chunking/parsing strategies, and real-time context freshness—ensuring our storage architectures evolve to handle the unique throughput, latency and accuracy demands at petabyte scale. 

 Serve as both Architect and Evangelist, shaping the technical roadmap while maintaining hands-on involvement in critical projects. Lead architecture reviews and performance optimizations for end-to-end AI Data Platform, from unstructured data ingestion and metadata enrichment to vector database sharding and reranking strategies. Prototype next-gen architectures that unify file storage, data lakes, and low-latency vector indexes into a cohesive, AI-ready data stack. 

 Lead a world-class research lab, mentoring top-tier engineers and researchers in the specialized fields of Information Retrieval (IR), AI Model, Data Lake, and retrieval mechanisms. Foster a culture of innovation and collaboration focused on solving the challenges for enterprise AI. 

 Shape industry standards by publishing influential research on Agent Memory, Knowledge Base, RAG, patenting novel approaches, and representing the company in top-tier tech forums (e.g., VLDB, SIGIR, NeurIPS) to define the future of AI-native data management.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
Location: US or Canada
 Type: US Applicants - Full-Time; Canadian Applicants - Independent Contractor

 **A note before you read further** 

 The world is changing fast, and so is this role. We can't fully tell you what this job looks like in six months. That's true of every role at Human Agency right now. What we need from you, no matter what: accountability, curiosity, and a builder-first mindset. If that sounds exciting, keep reading. If it sounds intimidating but you're still interested, let's talk. If none of that sounds like you, that's okay. This probably isn't your spot.

 About Human Agency 

 We’re scaling rapidly and have a growing pipeline of opportunities that demand exceptional talent across disciplines. Our mission is to bring on individuals, from creative producers to technical experts to entrepreneurial leaders, who can help us realize this next chapter of growth.

 We are a company of doers. Leaders roll up their sleeves, teams work flat, and everyone contributes to what ships. Titles don’t insulate us from feedback or basics. We invite critique, learn quickly, and keep raising the bar. The best ideas win here, no matter where they come from, because clients trust us to deliver the strongest outcomes every time.

 Our clients’ missions, products, and bottom lines are sacred. We immerse ourselves in their world, becoming stewards of their goals and partners in solving big problems. Every product, strategy, or asset we create must be both beautiful and functional; practical, usable, and designed for real-world impact.

 Humans are our most valuable resource, and we only grow by hiring people who push us forward. Across strategy, engineering, design, data, and operations, we seek out teammates who raise the bar and make us better. Always hire up, never down.

 We partner with organizations of all sizes to explore, design, and implement AI strategies that are secure, scalable, and human-centered. We believe AI should amplify human potential, not replace it and we build with that conviction in every engagement. From advisory and tooling to implementation and education, we meet clients where they are at and help them integrate AI in ways that align with their mission and values. Our goal is to empower teams to work smarter, move faster, and unlock new possibilities through thoughtful, responsible innovation.

 And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we care about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

 The Opportunity 

 This is not a traditional chief of staff role. At Human Agency, the chief of staff is the prototype for every person we hire. You're someone who wants to be running a company — a dynamic C-suite leader — but you're choosing to ride shotgun alongside an executive because you know it's the fastest path to getting there. What makes us different is that we actually give you that shot. Today. Not in three years.

 You are floor to ceiling. You will take out the trash, sweep the floors, and then walk into the board meeting and run it. Nothing is beneath you. There is no ceiling above you. You are a garbage disposal for problems — every food scrap, every random piece of metal gets thrown your way, and you figure out how to handle it without breaking.

 What You'll Do 

 Rather than being hired for a predetermined set of tasks, you will be brought on to solve complex, evolving challenges. Success in this role requires self-direction, proactive value creation, and the ability to thrive without constant oversight. Over the coming year, your responsibilities will be tailored to both organizational needs and your individual strengths, potentially including:

 Leading AI transformation projects with clients

 Leading fundraising efforts for funds or clients

 Managing investment funds

 Managing CEOs at client organizations

 Driving sales initiatives at Human Agency

 Partnering closely with recruiting to help grow our team

 Serving as CEO of a venture studio company

 Managing client project delivery

 Driving value through data and analytics for clients

 Leading go-to-market initiatives for clients

 Own and solve ambiguous, high-stakes problems that don't fit neatly into any department

 Manage yourself entirely — no hand-holding, no coaching, no check-ins about how your day is going

 Move between strategic work (board prep, investor materials, business development) and ground-level execution (scheduling, research, client fires) without blinking

 Deploy AI tools daily to amplify your output — you are not doing the work of one person, you are doing the work of five

 Identify opportunities, inefficiencies, and threats before anyone asks you to

 What We're Looking For 

 A fundamentally good human. Table stakes.

 Mission-driven operator with deep commitment to Human Agency's values and vision

 No ego. No job description. You do whatever the job requires.

 Self-managing problem solver — the last thing a CEO or Founder wants is someone they have to manage

 AI-first mindset — you use AI as a force multiplier across everything you touch

 Builder mentality — you've shipped something. Attach proof of something you've built with AI to either your application or cover letter. 

 Generalist with range — you don't need to be an expert in any one thing, but you need to be dangerous across many things

 Experience & Skills 

 5-7+ years in high-performing environments such as management consulting, venture capital/private equity, business development, or startup leadership positions

 Demonstrated success in taking ambiguous, complex initiatives and driving them to completion, you're the person who makes hard things happen

 Outstanding written and verbal communication; you can synthesize complex information into clear, actionable briefs for different audiences

 Bonus: Experience in high-growth startups, venture studios, or AI/tech companies

 Considerations 

 Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; top-tier programs and/or an advanced degree in a relevant field is a plus

 Ethics:  Commitment to ethical practices and responsible business operations

 Travel:  Occasional (10–25%) for company offsites, key events, and leadership meetings

 Location:  Remote-friendly with preference for candidates in major tech hubs and strong preference for overlap with EST business hours

 Equal Opportunity Commitment 

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse backgrounds and strive to build an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcomed and empowered.

 The Opportunity 

 We are seeking an exceptional Chief of Staff for our Managing Director of AI—someone who combines strategic vision in AI with hands-on execution and technological know-how. You'll be both a force-multiplier and a transformation architect: designing AI-enabled processes, building automated engines that run independently, leading organizational rollouts, and ensuring crisp execution across our AI solutions practice.

 This role goes beyond traditional Chief of Staff responsibilities. You'll design processes that leverage AI, build repeatable systems that scale, and lead entire client transformations from discovery to sustained adoption. You have the potential to grow into leading organizational-level AI implementations as the practice expands.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Strategic & Executive Leadership 

 Partner with the Managing Director of AI and the executive team to translate priorities into sequenced plans, resourcing, and measurable outcomes

 Lead Human Agency's AI transformation methodology: define offerings, build repeatable frameworks, and establish best practices for AI-enabled workflows

 Design end-to-end processes that embed AI tools (LLMs, automation platforms, knowledge assistants) into client workflows and internal operations

 Translate complex AI capabilities into clear business cases, use cases, and implementation roadmaps for executive audiences

 Produce high-quality executive materials (briefings, roadmaps, decision memos) that drive alignment and decisions

 Identify where AI creates leverage across client engagements and surface strategic opportunities to leadership

 AI Process Design & Automated Engines 

 Design and build AI-powered systems that operate independently with minimal ongoing intervention—automated engines that scale beyond individual engagements

 Create repeatable processes for AI implementation: discovery frameworks, solution architectures, evaluation routines, and governance models

 Design prompts, playbooks, and knowledge bases optimized for reliability, consistency, and reusability across multiple clients

 Implement lightweight automation using no/low-code tools (Zapier, Make, Airtable) integrated with AI capabilities

 Establish monitoring and feedback loops that enable self-correcting, continuously improving systems

 Document patterns and best practices that can be deployed at scale

 Client Service Delivery & Organizational Rollouts 

 Own end-to-end delivery on multiple client engagements involving AI-enabled solutions (e.g., knowledge assistants, workflow automations, content summarization, research copilots), from discovery through launch and sustained adoption

 Lead company-wide and client-wide AI adoption initiatives—managing stakeholder alignment, training, governance, and measurement across entire organizations

 Run comprehensive discovery to surface use cases, success metrics, risks, change-management needs, and technical requirements; translate findings into scopes, timelines, and clear acceptance criteria

 Coordinate solution build-outs with internal teammates and external partners: data/connectivity needs, tool selection, integration planning, prompt engineering, and rollout choreography

 Design change-management approaches that address skill gaps, cultural resistance, workflow disruption, and organizational readiness

 Partner with client leadership to sequence rollout phases, manage dependencies, and demonstrate ROI

 Quality, Governance & Evaluation 

 Set lightweight evaluation routines: accuracy metrics, latency benchmarks, cost tracking, quality assurance processes, and continuous improvement cycles

 Establish prompt/playbook management, basic safety/guardrail checks, and UAT plans

 Build governance frameworks that enable responsible, scalable AI adoption across organizations

 Implement monitoring systems that track performance, usage, and business impact

 Stakeholder Management & Enablement 

 Lead standing client check-ins, executive presentations, demo readiness, decision logs, and release notes, presenting succinct options and recommendations

 Create comprehensive enablement materials: user guides, FAQs, training programs, and governance playbooks that empower client teams to operate AI systems independently

 Build lasting client relationships through proactive communication, anticipation of needs, and consistent delivery quality

 Present to executive audiences with clarity and confidence, addressing concerns about accuracy, security, and adoption

 Operations & Project Management 

 Design and continuously improve the operating system for AI work: intake → triage → prioritization → delivery → QA → launch → measurement

 Manage staffing assignments and subcontractor contributions across concurrent workstreams; keep tools current (Asana/Notion, Google Workspace, Slack)

 Budget & scope control: track time against SOWs, flag changes early, manage vendors, and ensure on-budget delivery with clear documentation

 Establish shared dashboards for delivery health (timeline, risk, burn, dependency status) and run tight meeting cadences

 Communications & Reporting 

 Prepare agendas, briefings, and executive-ready presentations; synthesize complex information into actionable insights

 Provide clear, timely reporting to the Managing Director of AI and stakeholders on progress, risks, and decisions

 Contribute to Human Agency's AI thought leadership through documentation of best practices, case studies, and insights

 Who You Are 

 Experience & Skills 

 5-7+ years in operations, client services, product/program/project management, strategic support, consulting, or transformation roles with direct ownership of client-facing delivery

 Demonstrated success leading multi-stakeholder projects and organizational change initiatives end-to-end (scope, timelines, budgets, risk, and change management)

 Deep AI fluency: hands-on experience implementing LLM-enabled solutions, prompt engineering, workflow automation, and knowledge management systems; can shape prompts/playbooks, evaluate quality, and choose appropriate tools or vendors

 Strong understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, when to use AI, how to design for reliability, and how to manage risks responsibly

 Proven ability to design repeatable processes and systems that scale beyond individual projects

 Experience with no/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Zapier/n8n), knowledge bases, and modern AI tooling

 High proficiency with Google Workspace, Asana/Notion, Slack, and comfort with modern web and content tools; experience preparing polished executive documents and presentations

 Exceptional ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for non-technical audiences

 Bonus: Experience leading organizational-level technology rollouts, background in management consulting, familiarity with responsible AI considerations (privacy, data handling, consent, bias mitigation), or experience in AI/ML product development

 Mindset & Traits 

 Builder and operator: You design systems that work without constant oversight, not just execute tasks

 Strategic and tactical: Comfortable setting vision while rolling up sleeves for hands-on implementation

 AI pragmatist: Excited about possibilities but grounded in what actually delivers measurable value

 Mission-driven; systems thinker with bias for action

 Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence executive stakeholders and earn trust through delivery

 Calm under pressure with excellent judgment about when to escalate vs. solve independently

 Able to hold strategic context while driving tactical execution across multiple concurrent engagements

 Intellectually curious with strong learning agility, you stay current on AI capabilities and translate findings into practical applications

 Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists

 Considerations 

 Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; an advanced degree in business, technology, or a related field is a plus

 Ethics: Commitment to ethical practices and responsible AI (transparency, human oversight, privacy, bias mitigation)

 Travel: Regular (20–40%) for client activities, organizational rollouts, and events

 Location: Remote-friendly with preference for candidates in major tech hubs

 Compensation 

 This role offers a competitive base salary with performance-based bonuses and potential equity participation. Final compensation will vary based on experience, performance, and location.

 Why Join Human Agency 

 Join a team of thinkers and builders creating meaningful impact across sectors—with autonomy to lead, the resources to succeed, and room to grow. This role offers the opportunity to shape how organizations integrate AI at scale, with clear pathways to increased leadership responsibility as our practice expands.

 Equal Opportunity Commitment 

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse backgrounds and strive to build an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcomed and empowered.

 Represent Human Agency at the highest levels. You will be the face of the firm in boardrooms, private events, conferences, and executive forums. You will carry the mission, articulate the vision, and build the credibility required to win at this level.

 Collaborate on deal structure and closing. You open the door, but you stay in the room. You will work directly with leadership to shape the conversation, design the engagement, and close the partnership. This is a team sport, and you play offense.

 Experience & Skills

 You have an established, high-quality network of owners, founders, family office principals, PE partners, or C-suite executives at large enterprises. Your rolodex opens doors that most people spend years trying to access.

 You graduated from an elite MBA program — Harvard Business School, Stanford GSB, Wharton, Booth, Kellogg, or equivalent — and you've built on that foundation with real-world credibility and relationships.

 You have 10+ years of experience operating at senior levels in consulting, investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or enterprise sales — environments where trust, reputation, and relationship capital matter more than product demos.

 You have a track record of opening and closing high-stakes relationships. You know how to navigate complex organizations, multi-stakeholder decision processes, and long sales cycles without losing momentum.

 You are comfortable in any room. You can hold a conversation with a third-generation family business owner, a PE Managing Director, and a Fortune 500 CEO — and you know how to adjust your approach without losing authenticity.

 You have integrity and seriousness. You are not coasting on your pedigree or your last name. You are building something, and you want this role to be the proof of what you are capable of.

 This is the right role if you've spent years inside Big Four firms, strategy boutiques, or early-stage companies and found yourself frustrated by the gap between advice and execution. You know what good looks like, you've seen what happens when no one stays accountable for making it real, and you're done handing off decks to someone else's team. You want the whole thing - the strategy, the build, the proof.

 Client Engagement Leadership — Run AI transformation projects from discovery through delivery, serving as the primary client relationship owner and the person ultimately accountable for outcomes.

 Strategy and Execution, Both — Develop transformation roadmaps grounded in a client's actual constraints, then stay in the work long enough to see them implemented, not handed off.

 0-to-1 Product Building — Identify high-value AI use cases, prototype solutions, and shepherd them from concept to something clients can actually use, often building hands-on alongside the client's internal team.

 Executive-Level Communication — Translate complex AI concepts, technical constraints, and strategic tradeoffs into crisp, confident communication for boards, C-suites, and frontline operators alike.

 Go-to-Market and Growth Support — Contribute to business development, help scope new engagements, and actively deepen relationships with existing clients as their needs evolve.

 AI Tool Deployment — Apply AI tools aggressively across your own workflow and your clients', not as a demo, but as a working standard for how fast and how well this work can get done.

 Experience & Skills 

 5–8+ years of experience in management consulting, venture-backed startups, product strategy, or a combination, with direct ownership over outcomes, not just deliverables.

 Demonstrated track record of taking AI from concept to working reality in an organizational context — not just advising on AI strategy, but building or deploying something that worked.

 Fluency with the AI tooling landscape — foundation models, workflow automation, prompt engineering, and the judgment to know when to build versus buy versus recommend against.

 Proven ability to lead client relationships at the senior level, including navigating organizational politics, managing ambiguity, and keeping complex engagements on track without a safety net.

 Strong written and verbal communication — you can write a crisp executive brief, run a working session with a skeptical VP, and explain a technical architecture decision to a non-technical founder, often in the same day.

 Experience in 0-to-1 product building — you've shipped something, taken something from nothing to real, and you can speak concretely about how you did it.

 Bonus: Background in venture studios, high-growth AI or tech companies, or operator roles at the intersection of strategy and product.

 You're a builder first. Decks are useful; working things are better. You default toward making something real.

 You have no patience for the gap between strategy and execution and have spent your career closing it.

 You're curious about AI in a way that shows up in your actual work — you experiment, you break things, you have opinions formed by firsthand experience, not secondhand summaries.

 You do what the work requires. Not what's in scope, not what's comfortable, not what's in your lane.

 Logistics 

 Location: Remote-first; US and Canada eligible.

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry 

 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 

 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

 Instacart is a Flex First team 

 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. 

 Why this role is on the menu 

 Instacart is building a new, distinctive pillar of the Instacart Platform — an emerging portfolio of AI-driven retailer solutions — and the go-to-market infrastructure to scale it is being built right now. The opportunity is real, but translating it into scalable commercialization frameworks, pricing strategies, and GTM plans requires specialized expertise and a dedicated strategy and planning leader. We're hiring a Director of AI Solutions Strategy & Planning to lead that work end-to-end. This role sits at the intersection of enterprise strategy and frontier AI, working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Customer Success to shape how Instacart becomes the preferred technology partner for grocery retailers.

  

 What you'll cook up in your first year 

 A comprehensive GTM strategy for Instacart's AI-driven solutions is defined and in motion — spanning consumer experiences, ecommerce analytics, and enhanced retailer workflows — with clear positioning, pricing frameworks, and retailer onboarding playbooks in place.

 Cross-functional alignment across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal is established, with governance forums running smoothly and transparent decision-making processes embedded across GTM and product teams.

 Pilot programs and experimentation frameworks are launched and producing real impact — validating AI-powered products with real retailer feedback and iterating based on measurable performance metrics.

 Sales teams are enabled and equipped with AI-specific strategies, enablement materials, and training programs that accelerate adoption and pipeline velocity.

 Market intelligence and competitive analysis are regularly informing product and commercialization decisions, keeping Instacart's AI solutions competitive, scalable, and aligned with evolving retailer needs.

  

 The secret ingredients we're looking for 

 Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

 8+ years of experience in strategy, product commercialization, or GTM planning, with a proven track record of defining and executing strategies for emerging offerings and driving measurable market impact.

 Experience developing GTM strategies for AI-powered products, retailer solutions, or enterprise technology platforms.

 Deep understanding of AI technologies, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value for diverse audiences.

 Expertise in product positioning, pricing frameworks, and solution packaging.

 Strong analytical capabilities, including experience with modeling, forecasting, and evaluating solution performance.

 Exceptional cross-functional leadership skills with a track record of influencing stakeholders across Product, Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Finance.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills for simplifying complex concepts and presenting to internal and external audiences.

 Strong quantitative skills to help inform opportunity sizing, impact assessment, pricing strategy, and financial outlook in partnership with cross-functional peers.

 Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments, with a focus on iterative learning and innovation.

  

 Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

 Familiarity with conversational AI, ecommerce analytics, or retail technology applications.

 Advanced knowledge of AI product monetization models, including subscription, usage-based, and value-based models.

 MBA or advanced degree in business, technology, or a related field.

We're seeking a Director, Customer Success to lead the  Customer Success organization — accountable for post-live value realization  across the enterprise software portfolio.

You'll own retailer value realization, measured through adoption velocity, time-to-value, health score coverage, at-risk portfolio management, CSAT, and QBR quality across the portfolio. You'll partner closely with Business Development, who owns NRR, GRR, and expansion, by providing account health, risk signal, and expansion readiness. You'll also partner with Enterprise Solutions Delivery, Technology leadership, and Product on portfolio strategy, retailer signal, and roadmap adoption.

 This is a roll-up-your-sleeves leadership opportunity for someone who has personally led the transformation of CS from reactive enablement toward proactive business advisory, can hire and develop senior consultative talent, and thrives in a fast-paced, BD-led commercial environment with shared standards rather than rigid process. The role reports to the Senior Director, Enterprise Solutions, and is remote across the United States and Canada with a preference for proximity to Toronto for key cross-functional collaboration.

 About the Job

 Lead the Customer Success organization for the Enterprise Solutions  portfolio — owning value realization,  outcomes end to end, and partner closely with BD, who owns NRR, GRR, and expansion, by providing account health, risk signal, and expansion readiness.Build and develop a senior consultative CS bench by hiring, sponsoring, and ramping Customer Success Managers  who engage with retailer executives on ecommerce strategy, merchandising, and operations and who can credibly influence retailer P&L outcomes and roadmap adoption.

 Manage senior managers leading segments, setting standards for what good looks like across the CSM’s  — including QBR quality, growth planning, executive engagement, and renewal execution.

 Operate in a BD-led commercial environment as a true commercial peer to BD — preserving BD's ownership of the primary commercial relationship while owning post-sale accountability and surfacing churn, expansion, and escalation signal early and clearly.

 Partner with the Director of Enterprise Architecture & Engineering on shared-account coordination — ensuring the cross-org account team ( CS + Technical Account Managers (TAM’s) ) functions as one team to the retailer despite the functional ownership, with co-authored protocols and clean escalation paths.

 Own the consultative transformation roadmap — talent strategy, comp structure, operating cadence, and tooling shifts required to evolve CS from a feature-enablement function into a strategic business advisory function.

 Partner with the Director of Retailer Delivery on the implementation-to-success motion as a managed lifecycle (not a document handoff) — ensuring CS is engaged early, named handoff criteria are met, and accounts transition cleanly into early-lifecycle growth ownership.

 Operationalize the retailer segmented  model in CS — applying high-touch coverage and scaled/digital-first models, with clear exception protocols and capacity guardrails.

 Apply AI augmentation to scale CS coverage and quality without linear headcount growth — including health monitoring, account-prep automation, QBR/insight generation, and signal triage — partnering with the Technical org on tooling roadmap and adoption.

 Direct, accountable leadership of a customer success organization responsible for adoption velocity, time-to-value, health score, at-risk portfolio, CSAT, QBR quality and support BD with GRR, NRR, and expansion.

We're transforming the grocery industry 

 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 

 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

 Instacart is a Flex First team 

 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. 

 Overview 

 About the Team 

 Instacart’s Logistics Product team owns the multi-sided fulfillment engine that powers every order on the platform. We deliver fast and affordable delivery and pickup for customers; flexible, reliable, and competitive earnings for shoppers; and continuously improving efficiency and quality for the marketplace as a whole. Logistics runs on ML and optimization at its core — how we batch orders, match them to shoppers, position and pay shoppers for their work, and route them physically — making this one of the most technically deep and commercially consequential product areas at Instacart.

 About the Role 

 We’re looking for a Director of Product to lead the Logistics product organization and take it to its next phase of growth. This is a highly visible leadership role with executive sponsorship, owning a pillar with company-wide impact on Instacart’s long-term growth and profitability. You will set the multi-year vision and strategy for Logistics, lead and grow a team of product managers, and partner closely with engineering, machine learning, data science, and operations to build products that generate value for all sides of the marketplace. You will be responsible for key outcomes core to the company’s success  — fulfillment cost, speed, quality, and shopper experience — and trusted to make fast, high-quality decisions in a complex, ambiguous, and highly interconnected domain.

 About the Job 

 Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Logistics — spanning service coverage, delivery speed, order batching and routing, shopper matching, positioning, and pay — and drive cross-company momentum behind it.

 Partner with the company’s executive leadership to define, prioritize, and deliver the strategy, translating complex, interconnected tradeoffs into crisp narratives that align the organization.

 Solve complex fulfillment problems and build 0-to-1 products and services that create synergistic value across customers, shoppers, and retailers, while continuously improving efficiency, speed, and quality at scale.

 Lead, hire, develop, and grow a high-performing team of product managers; establish operating rhythms, hiring plans, and development frameworks that build a healthy, high-trust team and develop leaders who set the pace.

 Act as a trusted partner to engineering and ML leadership on complex, high-stakes technical tradeoffs; anticipate where to focus the team ahead of the business impact becoming obvious.

 Define clear success metrics and maintain a rigorous experimentation portfolio with a consistent cadence, using data, first-principles thinking, and user research to make sound, sometimes irreversible, tradeoffs.

 Lead cross-org initiatives that measurably improve org health, and mentor and uplevel PMs across the broader organization.

 About You 

 Minimum Qualifications 

 10+ years of product management or similar experience, including 4+ years managing and developing product managers (including senior PMs).

 Strong marketplace or systems thinking — the ability to reason about multi-sided marketplace interactions and long-term vs. short-term tradeoffs, heavily informed by data as well as user research.

 Proven track record leading multi-quarter initiatives and delivering impactful products measured by hard business outcomes (e.g., cost, speed, quality).

 Strong technical fluency with ML- and algorithms-driven products; comfortable working through complex technical tradeoffs alongside engineering and ML leaders.

 Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence executive leadership and align cross-functional teams in a complex domain.

 Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain high-performing PMs and build healthy, high-trust teams.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience in a multi-sided dynamic marketplace-oriented role, envisioning or evaluating algorithms-based products and services.

 Background in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, or operationally complex physical environments.

 Experience with e-commerce or grocery technology.

 #LI-Remote
 Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.

 Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

 For Canadian based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

 CAN
 $259,000 — $273,500 CAD

jobs.title: Director of Growth Marketing (SMB & Self Serve)
jobs.description:
About the Role 
 Hi, I'm Dan Davidow, Chief Marketing Officer at Jane. I joined Jane because I have a real passion for helping small businesses succeed, and our customers run some of the most impactful small businesses there are. When I'm not doing that, you'll usually find me planning my next trip.
 Jane has built strong momentum, and our next phase of growth will be driven by deeper relationships, trusted partnerships, and a strong presence in the healthcare community. We have also found success in our demand gen programs, and now is the time to build on what's already working.
 That's where you come in. As our Director of SMB & Self Serve Demand Generation, you'll own a core part of how Jane generates demand: our paid media program, our website (including SEO and AEO), and our lifecycle marketing. You'll work alongside the teams who own events, partnerships, and community, so that together it all adds up to one cohesive motion. AI is central to how you'll do this: from how practitioners discover Jane through AI-driven search, to how we use AI to plan, build, and optimize our own programs. You’ll also partner closely with our growth product team who works on onboarding and optimizing user flow.
 You'll lead a team of three channel experts today, with room to grow the team as the program scales, and partner closely with our Marketing Analytics & Operations team on measurement and infrastructure.
 This is a role for a leader who can balance strategy and execution. Part of this job is hands-on; you're comfortable working directly in the campaigns, data and tools, and building AI-assisted workflows yourself, not just directing from above. Success looks like building trust with our market and driving real business impact.

 What Impact We’re Looking for You to Make 
 Own paid media. Lead our paid media budget and team across channels, including paid search, paid social, direct mail, and more - deciding where we invest, how we measure it, and when we shift.

 Partner with Growth Product. You’ll work directly with designers, developers, and product managers building the future of onboarding and activation at Jane, designing and executing thoughtful tests.

 Deliver on web experience. Manage the marketing side of jane.com - the front door to Jane for practitioners, patients, and the broader healthcare community. Partner closely with design and engineering, and own site strategy, conversion rate, and our organic presence across both traditional search (SEO) and AI-driven discovery (AEO).

 Own lifecycle marketing. Design and run the programs that guide practitioners from first touch through trial, signup, and expansion, working closely with product marketing and sales on what happens at each stage.

 Put AI to work. Make Jane easy to find in an AI-first world, and use AI across the demand program itself - research, creative testing, campaign optimization, reporting - so a small team can operate like a much bigger one.

 Sharpen our measurement. We have a solid measurement foundation today. You'll define what the demand program needs next - KPIs, attribution, reporting - and partner with our Marketing Analytics & Operations team to build it.

 Align with Sales and Support. Work deeply with our sales and support teams to design demand programs that support revenue outcomes, not just top-of-page metrics.

 Build the team. Lead, coach, and grow a team of channel experts, and raise the bar on how we plan, test, and learn together.

 What Experience We Need 
 A strong track record in demand gen or growth marketing. 5-7 years driving tangible business impact, ideally with experience managing and scaling multi-million-dollar budgets.

 Deeply analytical. Exceptional at translating numbers into marketing strategy, and comfortable operating in a constrained, highly data-driven environment. Deep expertise across marketing analytics, web optimization, lifecycle, and paid acquisition.

 AI-forward. You're already using AI tools in your day-to-day marketing work, you have a point of view on how AI is changing search and discovery, and you're excited to keep experimenting.

 High-velocity SMB experience. Proven success in high-velocity business models, ideally SMB or consumer. We're not looking for someone whose experience is only account-based marketing or traditional enterprise SaaS.

 A strong collaborator. You know how to work with design, development, and product teams to drive results.

 A builder of teams. A track record of hiring and developing high-caliber growth marketing talent.

 If you don’t meet every single qualification but are excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

 More About Jane 
 Jane is a founder-led, high-growth SaaS company with a remote-first team working across Canada, the US, and the UK, united by our mission to help the helpers.

We build the products and tools that thousands of clinics rely on every day to run their businesses, care for their patients, and grow their communities. That level of impact means every person at Jane plays an important role in how we show up for our customers. We're all responsible for being deeply connected to their needs, obsessed with improving their experience, and proud of the difference our work makes in their day-to-day lives.

Jane is growing fast, and that growth brings exciting challenges that call for adaptability, resilience, learning agility, and humility. We're proud of what we've built and quick to admit what we don't know yet. We listen, learn, and adjust as we go. More than 70,000 businesses run on Jane which has 250,000+ practitioners interacting with our product on a daily basis and growth is continuing to accelerate.

Our goal isn't just delivery - it's delight. We move quickly, communicate openly, and solve real problems together. If you're energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and eager to learn with others, you'll thrive at Jane.

 Compensation & Benefits 
 At Jane, we're committed to paying fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. You'll see that our salary ranges are quite large - this is intentional. It reflects the full growth journey someone might take in the role, from developing skills early on to becoming highly proficient and ultimately achieving excellence. Most new hires join at the accomplished stage. A starting salary below this typically indicates a candidate with strong potential who is still developing key skills. Salaries above this usually apply to existing team members who have made a significant impact and bring deep Jane-specific knowledge.
 🇺🇸 For candidates based in the United States, the annual salary range is $187,200 - $265,000
 You can explore our benefits package here: US Benefits 

 🇨🇦 For candidates based in Canada, the annual salary range is $177,600 - $288,600.

 Jane takes job scams and candidate fraud seriously. Jane will only contact you from an @ jane.app email address. We'll never contact you from a personal email, ask for payment, or request purchases during the hiring process. If something doesn't seem right, please reach out to us at hiring@jane.app before sharing any personal information.

jobs.title: Associate Vice President, Salesforce Engineering & Development
jobs.description:
Lead, mentor, and develop five direct reports, including three Salesforce Development Managers, a Quality Engineering Lead, and a Salesforce Administration Manager, establishing clear accountability and effective leadership practices.

 Define and execute a multi-quarter engineering transformation roadmap covering software development standards, code quality, automated testing, security, technical debt, release management, observability, incident response, and production support.

 Oversee engineering delivery across three Salesforce scrum teams, partnering with Product Management on priorities, capacity planning, estimates, delivery commitments, and resource allocation.

 Establish a robust quality engineering framework, promoting early testing, developer-owned unit and integration testing, scalable automation, and measurable release quality standards.

 Standardize Git-based development workflows and release management practices, including deployment planning, environment coordination, release readiness, rollback procedures, and post-deployment validation.

 Evaluate and improve the Salesforce DevOps operating model, clarifying responsibilities for CI/CD pipelines, environment management, deployment automation, and release execution while reducing manual processes and operational dependencies.

 Collaborate with IT Architecture to maintain clear technical decision-making responsibilities, challenge impractical designs, identify technical risks, and ensure effective implementation of architectural standards.

 Drive AI-enabled engineering initiatives by assessing secure development assistants and automation opportunities, establishing governance and adoption guidelines, developing team capabilities, and measuring improvements in productivity and software quality.

 Oversee Salesforce administration and service-request operations, ensuring effective request intake, prioritization, support processes, issue resolution, escalation management, and service performance monitoring.

 Establish transparent engineering performance metrics covering delivery predictability, development cycle time, deployment frequency, change failure rates, recovery time, escaped defects, automation reliability, service responsiveness, and team health.

 Develop a sustainable talent and workforce strategy across North America and India, including recruitment, leadership development, onboarding, documentation, knowledge transfer, and distributed-team collaboration.

 Partner with Product, Architecture, Security, IT, and business leaders on major releases, critical incidents, and strategic technical decisions, providing clear communication on risks, priorities, and progress.

 Requirements:

 12+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on technical development experience and at least 5 years managing engineering managers or multiple development teams.

 Proven experience building, scaling, or transforming engineering organizations, particularly in environments requiring stronger processes, automation, technical governance, and operational accountability.

 Strong technical expertise in Salesforce engineering, including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), APIs and integrations, complex custom applications, deployment strategies, platform limitations, and production reliability.

 Ability to evaluate technical designs, challenge engineering decisions, and contribute to detailed technical discussions without necessarily serving as the primary developer.

 Demonstrated experience leading multi-team Agile engineering organizations with established practices in CI/CD, automated testing, source control, environment management, release coordination, and incident management.

 Experience collaborating with senior architecture stakeholders, defining decision-making responsibilities, establishing cross-functional agreements, and maintaining practical technical documentation standards.

 Strong people-management and leadership capabilities, with a track record of developing managers, building accountable teams, and improving collaboration across geographically distributed engineering organizations.

 Experience coordinating technical delivery with Product Management and other nontechnical business stakeholders.

 Practical knowledge of AI-assisted software development, including security considerations, code quality, developer adoption, and measurable productivity improvements.

 Excellent executive communication, strategic prioritization, stakeholder management, and organizational change leadership skills.

 Strong judgment and decision-making abilities, with the capacity to balance delivery speed, technical sustainability, operational risk, and business objectives.

 Nice to Have:

 Experience with highly customized Salesforce CPQ, quote-to-cash, pricing, contracting, or commercial operations platforms.

 Experience managing externally sourced development teams and improving operational processes and knowledge transfer.

 Previous responsibility for a Salesforce administration or service-request function alongside software engineering and quality engineering teams.

 Experience managing engineering and delivery teams across North America (Canada and the United States) and India.

 Benefits:

 Opportunity to lead a significant engineering transformation and shape the long-term Salesforce technology strategy.

 Executive-level leadership responsibility with direct influence over engineering standards, organizational development, and operational performance.

 Opportunity to build and develop a high-performing management team across multiple engineering functions.

 Exposure to innovative AI-assisted software development practices and modern engineering technologies.

 Collaborative, cross-functional working environment involving Product Management, IT Architecture, Security, and business leadership.

 Opportunity to lead and influence distributed teams across North America and India.

 Meaningful professional development through strategic leadership, organizational transformation, and technical innovation.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
Partner with the CEO and Executive Team to define corporate strategy, establish growth priorities, and guide financial planning and capital allocation decisions.

 Lead board-level financial communications, including preparing financial presentations, developing performance narratives, and supporting board committees.

 Manage investor relations, including shareholder communications, investor updates, financial data rooms, and due diligence processes.

 Develop and oversee capital strategies, including fundraising initiatives, debt financing, and preparation for potential mergers and acquisitions.

 Build, lead, and develop the finance function, initially managing a direct report while identifying future organizational and resource requirements.

 Own the annual operating plan, workforce planning, long-range financial models, and revenue and bookings forecasts.

 Oversee revenue modelling, cash flow management, liquidity, runway planning, and financial scenario analysis.

 Establish and monitor SaaS financial performance metrics, including Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), gross and net revenue retention, churn, bookings, and pipeline-to-revenue conversion.

 Analyze unit economics, including Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), customer lifetime value (LTV), payback periods, and gross margins, using cohort, churn, and expansion insights to support strategic decisions.

 Deliver monthly financial and operational performance reports to the Leadership Team and comprehensive quarterly reporting to the board.

 Maintain robust internal financial controls, audit readiness, revenue recognition practices, and compliance with Canadian and US tax requirements.

 Define the organization's legal and contract strategy while managing external legal counsel, including service scope, relationships, and associated costs.

 Establish and oversee contractual frameworks covering Master Subscription Agreements, Order Forms, Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), and partner, reseller, integration, and vendor agreements.

 Review and manage complex contract negotiations, school district contract amendments, non-standard commercial terms, and RFP responses, exercising signing authority within board-approved limits.

 Serve as Corporate Secretary, overseeing board and shareholder resolutions, meeting minutes, corporate records, and governance documentation.

 Manage the capitalization table and equity programs, including stock option grants, vesting schedules, equity plan administration, and fair market value (FMV) and 409A valuations.

 Oversee legal disputes, demand letters, and litigation matters in collaboration with external counsel.

 Lead corporate insurance and risk management programs, including general liability, cyber liability, errors and omissions (E&O), directors and officers (D&O), and employment practices coverage.

 Manage insurance broker relationships, policy renewals, certificates of insurance, and claims.

 Collaborate with the CEO, Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), and sales leadership to develop pricing, packaging, and commercial strategies.

 Establish pricing governance frameworks, including discount approval processes, non-standard contract terms, and deal desk oversight for complex district and multi-year agreements.

 Design annual sales and customer experience compensation plans, quotas, and incentive documentation in collaboration with commercial leadership.

 Oversee monthly sales commission processes, including calculations, approvals, clawbacks, commission splits, special performance incentives (SPIFs), and dispute resolution.

 Requirements:

 CPA designation is mandatory.

 12+ years of professional experience in finance and accounting, including at least 5 years in a senior finance leadership position such as CFO, VP of Finance, or equivalent.

 Previous senior leadership experience within a SaaS business or high-growth technology company.

 Demonstrated experience reporting directly to a CEO and presenting financial strategies and performance results to a Board of Directors.

 Proven ability to develop and execute financial strategies, operating models, and scalable financial structures that support businesses through different stages of growth.

 Strong expertise in SaaS financial metrics, subscription revenue models, unit economics, and translating financial performance into meaningful insights for board members and investors.

 Experience managing investor relations, fundraising activities, capital strategy, and financial due diligence.

 Strong commercial and legal understanding, including contract negotiations, external legal counsel management, and corporate governance.

 In-depth knowledge of revenue recognition, internal financial controls, audit processes, and cross-border taxation involving Canada and the United States.

 Experience developing and managing sales compensation structures, commission plans, pricing frameworks, and discount governance.

 Excellent financial modelling, forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning capabilities.

 Experience managing corporate insurance, enterprise risk, equity programs, and capitalization tables is highly valuable.

 Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex financial and commercial matters clearly to boards, leadership teams, and operational employees.

 Proven leadership and team-building capabilities, with a focus on developing people, systems, and processes that support sustainable growth.

 Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance business opportunities with financial, contractual, and operational risk.

 A collaborative and relationship-oriented leadership style, combining accountability, empathy, adaptability, and sound decision-making.

 Experience in EdTech, K-12 education, public-sector organizations, or local government is considered a significant asset, particularly familiarity with school district procurement, RFP processes, and contractual requirements.

 Previous experience leading a company through fundraising, acquisitions, or post-acquisition integration is an advantage.

 Corporate Secretary responsibilities, equity plan administration, and capitalization table management experience are additional assets.

 Experience overseeing legal and insurance functions in an organization without in-house legal counsel is also beneficial.

 Benefits:

 Total On-Target Earnings (OTE): CAD $250,000–$320,000, including base salary and variable compensation.

 Remote working opportunity based in Canada.

 Executive-level position with direct reporting to the CEO and membership in the Executive Team.

 Significant influence over corporate strategy, financial planning, capital allocation, and organizational growth.

 Opportunity to build and develop the finance function and shape its long-term structure.

 Annual compensation reviews in November, considering market benchmarks and individual performance.

 Compensation philosophy focused on fairness, market alignment, and rewarding measurable impact.

 Access to a comprehensive benefits and perks package.

 Supportive and collaborative working culture that values autonomy, shared ownership, and professional development.

 Opportunity to contribute to a meaningful mission focused on improving the educational experience for students and educators.

 Collaborative team environment that encourages innovation, curiosity, and the responsible use of AI-powered tools to improve productivity.

jobs.title: Customer Success Director
jobs.description:
Own customer revenue, retention, and expansion across a portfolio of strategic accounts, ensuring commercial objectives and customer outcomes remain aligned.

 Proactively identify growth opportunities, customer risks, and early churn signals, translating insights into clear actions and measurable results.

 Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning the business as a strategic partner rather than simply a service provider.

 Lead strategic account planning, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), commercial discussions, and major customer escalations.

 Ensure each strategic account has clearly defined objectives, accountable owners, customer health indicators, and a structured success plan.

 Lead, coach, and develop the Customer Success team, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and high performance.

 Collaborate with Business Development, Product, Data, Operations, and AI/Automation teams to resolve customer challenges and deliver on commitments.

 Design and implement scalable Customer Success processes covering onboarding, account health, reporting, customer lifecycle management, and churn prevention.

 Leverage CRM systems, data, and AI-powered automation to improve visibility, streamline workflows, and allow the team to focus on high-value customer interactions.

 Act as the voice of the customer, bringing feedback and insights into product development, commercial strategy, and operational priorities.

 Requirements:

 10+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Strategic Accounts, or a comparable commercial leadership role.

 Proven track record of owning and improving customer revenue, retention, and/or account expansion.

 Demonstrated experience managing high-value or enterprise customers and building strong relationships with senior stakeholders and executive decision-makers.

 Previous people leadership experience, including the ability to coach, challenge, motivate, and develop high-performing teams.

 Strong commercial judgment and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret account performance, identify opportunities, and address customer risks.

 Excellent communication, negotiation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills.

 A strong ownership mindset, proactive approach, and ability to make sound decisions in a fast-moving environment where priorities may change.

 Preferred qualifications: Hands-on experience with CRM or Customer Success platforms, along with an interest in AI, automation, and technology-enabled approaches to Customer Success.

 Candidates who do not meet every listed preference are still encouraged to apply if they bring relevant experience and the ability to make an impact.

 Benefits:

 Work arrangement: Fully remote, with the flexibility to work from anywhere.

 Employment type: Part-time leadership opportunity.

 Strategic ownership: Direct responsibility for customer revenue, retention, account growth, and team performance.

 Opportunity to shape the function: Play a central role in defining and developing the Customer Success strategy and operating model as the organization grows.

 AI-first environment: Work within a business built around seven specialized AI agents, with data and automation integrated into everyday operations.

 Cross-functional impact: Collaborate with teams across Business Development, Product, Data, Operations, and AI/Automation.

jobs.title: Director of Human Resources
jobs.description:
Develop and execute the HR strategy in alignment with business objectives, translating organizational priorities into workforce planning, hiring strategies, and organizational design recommendations.

 Lead the HR function, manage its budget, develop team capabilities, establish priorities, and oversee internal and external HR service delivery.

 Partner with senior leadership and Finance to provide data-driven insights and recommendations on workforce planning, organizational structure, headcount, and talent needs.

 Oversee core HR operations, including onboarding, offboarding, employee benefits, leave management, employee records, immigration coordination, and employee support.

 Ensure the reliability and continuous improvement of payroll, benefits administration, HR systems, employee data management, and related processes.

 Lead complex employee relations matters, including investigations, performance concerns, sensitive employment decisions, and risk management, while supporting managers in handling day-to-day people challenges.

 Maintain effective HR policies and practices, ensuring compliance with employment regulations across Canada, the United States, and the United Kingdom, in collaboration with local legal advisers.

 Strengthen performance management, career development, promotion, and talent review practices in partnership with business leaders.

 Collaborate with Talent Acquisition to identify workforce priorities and support recruitment for critical positions.

 Own compensation and rewards frameworks, including job leveling, salary bands, market benchmarking, and annual compensation review cycles.

 Support compensation decisions, equity administration, and people-related due diligence during financing rounds and other significant organizational events.

 Requirements:

 At least 8 years of progressive experience in Human Resources, including a minimum of 3 years leading an HR team, function, or major HR program.

 Proven experience building and managing a lean HR function through significant organizational growth, ideally supporting companies with 200+ employees.

 Experience supporting both technical and frontline workforces, with demonstrated success designing, implementing, and managing scalable HR systems and processes.

 Strong expertise in employee relations, including workplace investigations, performance management, sensitive employee matters, and complex employment decisions.

 Solid experience in workforce planning, organizational design, compensation structures, performance management, and talent development programs.

 Practical knowledge of U.S. multi-state employment requirements and experience coordinating international employment matters with local specialists.

 Familiarity with HRIS platforms and employee data management controls; experience with Rippling or comparable HR systems is an advantage.

 Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills, with the ability to advise executives, support managers, and build trust with employees.

 Strong judgment, discretion, problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to manage confidential and sensitive situations effectively.

 A relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience.

 Experience in technology, manufacturing, aviation, robotics, aerospace, or other safety-conscious industries is preferred.

 Exposure to international teams across Canada, the United States, and/or the United Kingdom is an advantage.

 Experience supporting financing events, equity administration, or the growth of a lean HR function is desirable.

 Professional certifications such as SHRM-SCP or SPHR, or a relevant master's degree, are considered an asset.

 Benefits:

 Competitive annual salary ranging from CA$180,000 to CA$230,000, depending on experience and qualifications.

 Equity participation, offering the opportunity to share in the company's long-term growth.

 Full-time employment with a hybrid working arrangement based in Toronto, Canada.

 Opportunity to take on a strategic leadership position with direct exposure to senior executives.

 Significant influence over HR strategy, organizational development, and company-wide people initiatives.

 The opportunity to build and scale HR processes and practices within a growing, innovative technology environment.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing and Communications
jobs.description:
As Director of Marketing and Communications, you will lead the organization's integrated marketing and communications strategy, develop a high-performing team, and ensure that all initiatives contribute to its broader mission and long-term objectives. Your key responsibilities will include:

 Build and lead a high-performing team: Recruit, coach, and develop senior leaders responsible for Media, Brand and Content, and Marketing, empowering them to build effective teams and deliver outstanding results.

 Define the department's organizational structure, capabilities, priorities, and performance expectations while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, trust, and continuous development.

 Develop and execute an integrated strategy: Establish an ambitious marketing and communications strategy that strengthens brand positioning, advances organizational priorities, and increases awareness and understanding of the movement and its principles.

 Identify opportunities to reach new audiences, develop creative campaigns and initiatives, and convert awareness and interest into meaningful engagement and action.

 Shape public narratives and protect organizational reputation: Guide external communications and ensure messaging is accurate, accessible, compelling, and appropriate for different audiences.

 Exercise independent editorial judgment, oversee high-profile communications, and manage sensitive topics, public scrutiny, and potential reputational challenges.

 Maintain trust and credibility with existing communities, major donors, senior leadership, and other important stakeholders.

 Build strategic relationships across the ecosystem: Collaborate with leaders and communications teams at aligned organizations to identify shared opportunities, coordinate initiatives where appropriate, and strengthen public understanding of the movement.

 Contribute to organizational leadership: Act as a strategic partner to the CEO and senior leadership team, helping shape organizational direction and ensuring communications priorities align with broader business and mission objectives.

 Challenge established approaches, identify opportunities to build new capabilities, and introduce innovative initiatives that increase the organization's reach and impact.

 Communicate strategic risks, trade-offs, and progress clearly to senior stakeholders while ensuring alignment across functions.

 Requirements

 The ideal candidate is a strategic and entrepreneurial leader with deep expertise in at least one major marketing or communications discipline and the ability to lead specialists across complementary areas. You should bring:

 Significant professional experience and a strong track record in at least one of the following areas: marketing, communications, media relations, or brand strategy.

 Broad expertise across marketing and communications disciplines, with the ability to develop integrated strategies and recruit, guide, and empower specialists with complementary skills.

 Substantial experience leading teams through managers or senior leaders, including coaching, developing talent, building alignment, and delivering results through others.

 Demonstrated experience building and scaling teams or organizational functions in startups or similarly fast-growing environments.

 Proven ability to attract exceptional talent, establish clear expectations, manage performance, and develop high-performing teams.

 Experience working in publicly visible or reputationally sensitive environments, with the judgment and composure to lead effectively under scrutiny.

 Strong editorial judgment and the ability to independently assess the accuracy, clarity, and appropriateness of communications across different audiences.

 An entrepreneurial and ambitious mindset, with the ability to challenge assumptions, develop new initiatives, operate without a predefined playbook, and translate strategic ideas into execution.

 Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, including the ability to keep senior leaders informed about progress, risks, and strategic trade-offs.

 Strong alignment with the organization's mission and core principles, together with the ability to engage thoughtfully with effective altruism's ideas, arguments, and debates. Previous employment in or long-standing membership of the effective altruism community is not required.

 Excellent communication, leadership, and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance strategic direction and operational execution.

 Additional assets that would strengthen your application:

 Direct experience managing crisis communications, public controversies, or significant reputational challenges.

 Experience leading communications strategies for mission-driven organizations, global communities, or complex multi-stakeholder environments.

 Ability to navigate sensitive public narratives while maintaining credibility and strong relationships with diverse audiences.

 Benefits

 International compensation adjusted from the US salary using a fixed exchange rate and converted into the candidate's local currency.

 Private health insurance.

 Flexible working hours and a fully remote working environment.

 Annual professional development allowance of $6,000.

 Annual mental health support allowance of $6,000.

 Extended parental leave.

 Ergonomic equipment to support a comfortable and productive working environment.

 At least 25 days of paid vacation annually, or the applicable country-specific entitlement if greater.

 Access to an office in Oxford, United Kingdom.

 Opportunities to collaborate with an international team and attend approximately 4–6 annual trips, including team retreats and international events.

 Full-time position with an anticipated start date of January 2027 or earlier.

 Inclusive working environment that welcomes candidates from diverse backgrounds and experiences.

 Reasonable accommodations available for candidates with disabilities throughout the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Director, Brand & Editorial
jobs.description:
Define the company's market point of view and own its brand narrative, voice, and editorial standards across external channels.

 Develop strategies to increase brand visibility and share of voice in conversations involving general partners (GPs), limited partners (LPs), and their professional advisors.

 Build a research and editorial program using proprietary platform data, industry benchmarks, and expert insights to produce reports, newsletters, recurring content series, and long-form thought leadership.

 Identify influential networks across GPs, LPs, fund counsel, auditors, placement agents, and fund administrators, and distribute relevant insights through these communities.

 Equip partnership and pipeline teams with research and messaging that support relationship-building and business development.

 Develop company executives and subject-matter experts into credible public voices through thought leadership, social content, and executive social programs, including ghostwriting when needed.

 Lead the corporate website's narrative, content strategy, and structure, ensuring it communicates a consistent market perspective and builds audience trust.

 Partner with product marketing to align product and asset-class pages with the broader brand narrative and positioning.

 Identify priority industry topics and lead SEO and content initiatives that build authority across traditional and AI-powered search.

 Recruit, manage, and develop content, web, and social teams, establishing editorial workflows, planning processes, quality standards, and performance measurement.

 Integrate practical AI tools into content operations to improve quality, efficiency, and scalability.

 Track and report performance indicators, including share of voice, branded search, audience growth, and engagement among target audiences.

 Requirements

 At least 8 years of experience in brand, editorial, or content leadership, including experience building and managing multidisciplinary teams.

 Demonstrated success establishing editorial authority for a B2B brand in a specialized, relationship-driven market.

 Experience developing contributor, community, or expert-voice programs that help a company's ideas spread through professional networks.

 Introduce participatory learning practices, including reflection exercises, evaluation activities, learning conversations, and strategy reviews.

 Experience designing, implementing, or administering sales compensation and commission programs.

 Advanced spreadsheet and financial modelling skills, with a strong focus on data accuracy and reporting reliability.

 Strong leadership, organizational, and relationship-building abilities, combined with sound commercial judgment and problem-solving skills.
