jobs.title: Director of Retention & Lifecycle
jobs.description:
A profitable DTC pet brand is looking for a Head of Retention & Customer Experience to join our team! You will own everything after the first order: subscriptions, email and SMS, the post-purchase journey and customer experience, across both of our brands.
 We're doing $50M+ a year and scaling to $100M+, and we want one senior leader who owns retention A-Z: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value and a better customer experience across the board. We are looking to hire someone with 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, who has led retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). The ideal candidate is hands-on in Klaviyo and Loop (or similar), has led a retention and customer experience team, and has managed agencies.
 The mission of this role 
 Own retention A-Z to fuel the growth to 9-figures. This role comes in to drive three things: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value, and a better customer experience across the board. Success is lower churn, stronger retention, much higher lifetime value, more revenue from email and SMS, and happier customers.
 Who are we? 
 We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
 What is our culture like & who is a good fit? 
 Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
 Better Everyday: have a retention test live every week across subscriptions, flows or the post-purchase experience, and write down what each result teaches.
 Speed Is King: spot a churn, refund or CSAT problem the day it shows up and have a fix in motion that week.
 Work Smart: AI and automation first. Claude reads cancellation reasons, reviews and tickets to find why customers leave, AI drafts flow copy and segments, and retention KPIs report themselves every week.
 Overdeliver: bring the CEO the next big retention lever before being asked, and get more lifetime value from every customer than the plan called for.
 If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. 
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.
 Outcomes (what success looks like) 
 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.
 Churn goes down: monthly subscription churn and save rate, by brand
 Retention improves: repeat purchase rate and cohort retention at 3, 6 and 12 months
 Lifetime value rises significantly: 12-month lifetime value by cohort and brand vs the same cohorts last year
 Email and SMS drive more revenue: email and SMS share of total revenue, and revenue per recipient
 Customers are happier across the board: CSAT, review rating, refund rate and tickets per order
 Key Objectives 
 Own the subscription program for both brands: offers, cadence, bundles, the customer portal and the cancellation flow.
 Build and test save offers, skip, swap and pause options, and win-back flows to cut churn.
 Own email and SMS strategy for both brands, and manage the retention agency's calendar, flows, targets and results.
 Build the lifecycle journey from first order to loyal customer: welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and VIP flows.
 Map and improve the full post-purchase journey, and run a loyalty, referral or VIP program if the numbers support it.
 Lead the customer experience team and set customer service policy that protects both the customer and the margin.
 Report cohort retention and lifetime value against target every month, and name the biggest lever.

jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description:
About Foundation 
 Foundation helps B2B tech and SaaS brands get found, cited and recommended when their buyers ask AI for solutions. We do it through Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): the research, content, distribution and optimization that build a brand's presence across LLMs, search, Reddit, YouTube and the sources they draw on.
 Mission of the Role  
 You own the quality bar for everything creative Foundation delivers: written content, design, video, and social and ad creative. You make sure the work clients get is clear, distinctive and built to be found and cited, and that every pod holds it to the same standard. Your job is making the work better and keeping it that way as we grow.
 You work across all of our client teams. Each team is led by a Group AEO Marketing Director who owns a book of clients, with an AEO Program Director who runs delivery. Our writers, designers, editors and producers sit in those pods. The Head of Paid Media, the Head of Organic & AI Visibility and their leads set the standard for their channels. You hold the creative bar across all of them.
 Reports to: Head of Client Services. Direct reports: creative makers not yet placed in pods. Dotted line: the writers, designers, editors and producers in every pod and through our freelance partners.

 What you'll own: 

 The quality gate. You design the creative quality check every piece goes through before it reaches a client: the criteria, the checklists, and who runs it in each pod. Pods run the check day to day. You review a sample of work each week, handle escalations, and personally review high-stakes work, such as a new client’s first deliverables. Work that isn’t ready goes back with feedback the maker can act on.
 The creative standard. You set and document what great looks like at Foundation: guidelines, examples, storytelling and brand frameworks, and the checklists the gate uses. 
 Your team. You manage and develop the creative makers who aren't yet placed in pods. The resource manager staffs them across pods. When each pod can keep one busy, they move into pods and stay on your dotted line.
 Creative hiring. You run the technical skill assessment part of every creative hire and have a veto on creative quality.
 Creative levelling. You define what each level of writer, designer, editor and producer looks like, and give input on their promotions.
 Coaching. You give the people who make the work regular, specific feedback, train them, and close skills gaps across pods.
 AI in the creative workflow. You build and roll out AI tools and workflows that raise quality and speed, and make sure AI-assisted work still meets the bar.
 Partners and freelancers. You make sure third-party creators and editors meet the same standard as our own team.

 What you bring:

 8+ years in creative leadership for B2B brands, in an agency or in-house, with a portfolio across writing, design and video.
 You've built a quality system before: standards, review gates and feedback loops that held up as volume grew.
 You make the call. You hold the bar under deadline pressure and say no when work isn't ready, without needing someone more senior to back you.
 You've already built things with AI: agents, tools or workflows you use in real creative work, and you can show us how you built them. Hands-on time with tools like Claude, Figma, Higgsfield, HeyGen or ElevenLabs counts. If you haven't built with AI yet, this role isn't the right fit right now.
 Experience teaching others: you've made writers, designers and editors better, including people who don't report to you.
 A clear point of view on what makes content get found and cited by AI assistants, and how that changes the creative brief.

 Position Details: 
 Full-time (Monday to Friday, ~40 hours/week), Full Remote
 Target Location: Canada, USA
 Compensation: Base salary 110k–135k depending on experience and location
 Variable compensation: Target 10% of base, tied to KPIs
 Where you land in the range depends on experience. US ranges may be adjusted for cost of labor in your state. Benefits are on top of base.

 How to apply
 Fill in Culture Index survey: https://surveys.cultureindex.com/s/4kEG9f2LvZ/125023 
 Apply through the application form

jobs.title: Director of Brand & Communications
jobs.description:
A profitable DTC pet brand doing $50M+ a year, scaling to $100M+, fully remote is looking for an experienced brand consultant, freelancer or agency to lead our brand revamp and set our brand direction as Head of Brand & Community, on a project / consultant basis! You will own how people see and feel about our two brands: the brand story and identity, and the brand moments that build awareness and goodwill, including shelter and charity partnerships, activations and events, PR and community.
 We are looking for someone who has done it before and really understands building a brand: creating brand moments and knowing how to actually make them happen, so we build our brand and brand awareness from the ground up. The ideal candidate has 7+ years in brand, communications or brand marketing at consumer brands, a track record of building awareness through cause partnerships, events and PR, and has run campaigns for a North American audience.
 The mission of this role
 Make our brands the most loved and trusted pet brands in North America, not just the most bought. You will own how people see and feel about our brands: a clear brand story and identity used everywhere, and the brand moments that build awareness and goodwill, including shelter and charity partnerships, activations and events, PR and community. Success is more people searching for us by name, more customers coming from word of mouth, more earned press, and a giving-back program customers know us for.
 Who are we?
 We're a profitable DTC pet brand selling premium stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a dog brand, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
 What is our culture like & who is a good fit?
 Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
 Better Everyday: review every brand moment against its goal, and make the next one bigger, cheaper or better.
 Speed Is King: jump on cultural moments and press opportunities the same day, and launch every brand moment on schedule.
 Work Smart: use partners, agencies and AI instead of a large team. For example, use Claude to draft press pitches and partner outreach, track media mentions, turn reviews into customer stories, and build the monthly brand-health report from search, survey and press data.
 Overdeliver: bring the CEO new partnership and brand-moment ideas before being asked, and get more press and goodwill from each moment than the plan called for.
 If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. 
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.
 Outcomes (what success looks like)
 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date. 
 More people know and search for our brands: branded search volume and direct traffic, monthly vs the same month last year
 More new customers come from word of mouth and press: share of new customers who say friend, family, press or social (not an ad) in the post-purchase survey
 We earn press and attention: earned media mentions and their reach each quarter, including press from each brand moment
 Our giving-back program makes a real, visible impact: shelters partnered, pets helped, and product and dollars donated each quarter, shown on the website
 The brand looks and sounds the same everywhere: quarterly brand audit across website, packaging, ads, email and social
 Key Objectives
 Own the brand story, positioning, tone of voice and brand guidelines for both brands, and keep the two brands distinct.
 Design and run a giving-back program with shelter and rescue partners that customers know us for, and track its impact.
 Build the yearly brand-moment calendar and run each moment end to end: concept, partners, budget, website and email, social and creators, and press.
 Run pop-ups, events, sponsorships and stunts, each with its own budget and goal.
 Win earned media: pitch every brand moment, cause campaign and launch, directly or through a PR agency you manage.
 Build a super-fan community and turn customer reviews, photos and stories into brand content.
 Report brand health monthly and own the brand budget.

jobs.title: Technical Director
jobs.description:
About Parallelz 
 Parallelz is building a new technology platform for delivering and discovering mobile applications. We let developers turn existing mobile apps and games into web-native experiences that run instantly in the browser, anywhere, with no changes to their code and no app store in between. Our games now run inside partner platforms, and we are scaling the system that delivers them.
 AI is central to how we work. Every engineer pairs with capable agents, and agentic workflows run through how we triage, build, review, ship and operate. Our team and advisors include technologists from Google, Mozilla and MIT Media Lab, and we are backed by global venture funds and angel investors.
 About the Role 
 As Technical Director, you will own the technical direction of Parallelz and lead a senior engineering team. You will work closely with the CEO and product leadership to turn priorities into architecture. You will stay close to the code: setting the design for the hardest problems, reviewing the work that matters, and building the agent-driven engineering system the team ships through.
 This role suits a builder who has grown into leadership and still designs, writes and reviews software every day.
 We value in-person collaboration. This role is based in our downtown Toronto office three or more days per week.
 What You'll Do 
 Own the architecture and technical roadmap across our platform, balancing performance, reliability and cost as usage grows.
 Lead hands-on on the hardest technical problems, working alongside senior engineers from design through production.
 Design and run our AI-native development system: the agent workflows, guardrails and quality gates that take work from ticket to production.
 Turn product and partner priorities into clear technical plans, and own delivery of the platform behind our live products and host integrations.
 Grow a senior team with high standards for craft and AI-native work, and lead hiring and development for your reports.
 Represent Parallelz technically with partners and across the wider group, including architecture reviews and technical due diligence.

jobs.title: Head of Ecommerce Growth
jobs.description:
At Hadley Designs, we believe early learning should be joyful, screen-free, and filled with connection.
 Founded by Becca Hadley, a former teacher and mom who began creating hand-drawn learning tools at her kitchen table, we’ve grown into a leading early childhood education brand trusted by millions of parents, grandparents, and teachers. Our products are developmentally sound, emotionally engaging, and intentionally designed to help children ages 3–8 grow curious, confident, and resilient.
 We serve busy, intentional families who are tired of screens and want more meaningful ways to teach and connect with their kids. From educational posters to busy books, handwriting guides to emotional learning kits, every product is crafted with care and rooted in research.
 Our vision is bold: to become the most trusted children’s brand in the world, present in millions of homes, and passed down for generations, while reaching $100 million in annual revenue by 2030.
 Today, Hadley Designs is an approximately $25 million ecommerce brand selling across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, and other channels. We've built a strong foundation, an established customer base, and a talented team of specialists. Now, our next chapter is about building a repeatable, profitable growth engine that can take us from $25 million to $100 million and beyond.
 We're looking for an entrepreneurial Head of Growth who has helped scale ecommerce brands before and knows how to turn growth opportunities into measurable business results. Someone who can see the bigger picture, connect the dots across channels, align talented teams, and determine where to invest, what to scale, and what to stop.

 This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership of our growth strategy, build systems that consistently generate profitable demand, and help shape the next stage of Hadley Designs.

 Role Overview 
 The Head of Growth is responsible for building and leading Hadley Designs' next phase of profitable growth, developing a repeatable demand generation engine that can scale our business from $25 million to $100 million and beyond.
 This is a hands-on growth leadership role that combines strategic thinking, financial accountability, and cross-functional execution. We're looking for someone who thinks like an entrepreneur, understands the economics of scaling an ecommerce brand, and knows how to turn promising opportunities into profitable, repeatable growth systems.
 We've built a talented team of specialists across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, paid media, creative, and affiliate marketing. The Head of Growth connects the dots between these functions, aligning priorities, coordinating execution, removing bottlenecks, and ensuring our investments translate into measurable business results.
 This person doesn't need to be the best specialist in every channel, but they must know how to lead specialists, challenge assumptions, diagnose performance, and make the entire growth engine more effective. They take ownership of growth initiatives from strategy through execution, without relying on the CEO to drive every decision.
 The role is channel agnostic. We don't care whether our next major growth opportunity comes from Meta advertising, Amazon external traffic, Shopify, TikTok Shop, creator partnerships, AI-powered content, or an entirely new channel. What matters is identifying where the greatest opportunities exist, validating them through disciplined experimentation, and allocating resources toward what produces profitable, incremental growth.
 Equally important is knowing what not to pursue. The Head of Growth must be willing to challenge existing strategies, stop underperforming initiatives, and redirect resources toward higher potential opportunities.
 The vision: Build a diversified, scalable, and profitable growth engine that consistently generates new customer demand, turns successful experiments into repeatable systems, and operates without requiring the CEO's daily involvement, ultimately helping Hadley Designs become a $100 million brand by 2030.

Metrics that You'll Own 
 Incremental Contribution Profit: Generate at least $1,000,000 in annual incremental contribution profit from growth initiatives, after all attributable variable marketing and program costs.
 Incremental Demand Generation Revenue: Generate at least $7,000,000 in annual incremental revenue through paid media, affiliate marketing, creator partnerships, and new acquisition channels, regardless of whether customers purchase through Amazon, Shopify, or TikTok Shop.
 Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER): Achieve a minimum 3.0x blended MER across the defined growth portfolio, while meeting contribution profit targets. Final target subject to validated channel economics.
 Growth Experiments: Execute at least 1 meaningful growth experiments per month (12 annually), each with a documented hypothesis, an approved budget, contribution profit target, performance review, and predefined stop criteria.
 Scalable Growth Engines: From the list of 12 growth experiments, at least 3 new experiments are repeatable, profitable growth engines annually, each generating at least $25,000 in incremental monthly revenue with positive contribution profit for three consecutive months.

 Primary Objectives 20% BIG ROCKS – These must be done first and at all costs.
 Build a Repeatable, Profitable Demand Generation Engine: Develop and scale sustainable sources of customer acquisition and revenue across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, paid media, affiliates, and emerging channels, prioritizing incremental contribution profit over revenue alone.
 Integrate and Lead Cross-Functional Growth Execution: Align existing specialists across creative, paid media, ecommerce, affiliates, and analytics around shared priorities. Own execution plans, remove bottlenecks, and ensure growth initiatives deliver measurable results without requiring the CEO's daily involvement.
 Own Growth Strategy and Marketing Investment Efficiency: Evaluate marketing performance using contribution margin, MER, acquisition costs, and incremental revenue. Determine where to allocate resources, what to double down on, and what to reduce or stop to maximize profitable growth.
 Build a Disciplined Growth Experimentation System: Identify new growth opportunities, launch at least 1 measurable experiment monthly, and systematically evaluate results. Turn winning experiments into repeatable, scalable growth systems while quickly discontinuing underperforming initiatives.
 Optimize Affiliate, Influencer, and Cross-Channel Demand Generation: Develop a profitable creator and affiliate strategy that connects TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, and paid media. Ensure winning creator content, partnerships, and emerging AI opportunities are integrated into the broader growth strategy rather than operating as isolated programs.

 Regular Work Activities 80% – These must be done ongoing daily/weekly after the BIG ROCKS are complete. 
 GROWTH STRATEGY & PERFORMANCE 
 Monitor growth performance across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, paid media, affiliates, and emerging acquisition channels.
 Identify opportunities to increase profitable revenue through improved customer acquisition, conversion rates, offers, retention, and demand generation.
 Evaluate competitive strategies, emerging marketing trends, AI technologies, and new acquisition channels to identify opportunities worth testing.
 Maintain a prioritized pipeline of growth opportunities based on potential financial impact, resources required, and probability of success.
 Challenge existing strategies and recommend where to increase investment, improve execution, or discontinue underperforming initiatives.
 MARKETING ECONOMICS & CAPITAL ALLOCATION 
 Own the performance of the growth investment portfolio, including budgets, incremental revenue, marketing costs, and contribution profit.
 Review marketing efficiency ratio (MER), customer acquisition costs, conversion rates, and contribution margins across relevant channels.
 Work with Finance and Analytics to validate attribution, incremental performance, and profitability.
 Allocate approved marketing and experimentation budgets toward the highest potential growth opportunities.
 Identify inefficient spending and make timely decisions to scale, optimize, or stop initiatives.
 Ensure marketing investments are evaluated based on actual business outcomes rather than attributed revenue or platform ROAS alone.
 CROSS-FUNCTIONAL GROWTH LEADERSHIP 
 Coordinate growth initiatives across Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, paid media, creative, affiliates, and analytics.
 Establish clear priorities, responsibilities, deadlines, and measurable outcomes for cross-functional growth projects.
 Lead weekly growth meetings focused on performance, bottlenecks, opportunities, and decisions.
 Ensure creative strategies, offers, customer acquisition campaigns, and product launches are aligned across relevant channels.
 Remove execution bottlenecks and hold initiative owners accountable for delivering results.
 Connect insights and winning strategies between teams so successful ideas can be tested and scaled across channels.
 GROWTH EXPERIMENTATION & EXECUTION 
 Launch and oversee at least 1 meaningful growth experiment monthly, each with a documented hypothesis, budget, owner, and success criteria.
 Coordinate experiment execution through existing specialists, internal teams, and external partners.
 Review results and distinguish meaningful performance improvements from temporary fluctuations or attribution noise.
 Document learnings and make clear decisions to scale, improve, continue testing, or stop each initiative.
 Turn successful experiments into repeatable growth systems with clear ownership and operating procedures.
 Maintain a centralized growth experiment tracker and prioritized testing roadmap.
 AFFILIATE, INFLUENCER & CREATOR GROWTH 
 Oversee the strategy and profitability of the affiliate and influencer program across TikTok Shop, Amazon, and Shopify.
 Evaluate creator acquisition, activation, retention, commissions, samples, incentives, and program economics.
 Direct the affiliate operations team to improve creator productivity and program profitability.
 Identify opportunities to develop high-value creator partnerships and expand creator driven demand generation.
 Ensure winning creator content is systematically shared with paid media teams and tested across appropriate channels.
 Integrate affiliate marketing, creator content, and AI influencer strategies into the broader growth engine.
 AGENCY, PARTNER & TEAM MANAGEMENT 
 Evaluate, select, and manage external marketing agencies, technology providers, and strategic growth partners.
 Establish clear performance expectations, financial targets, and accountability for outside partners.
 Lead growth initiatives through existing channel specialists without creating unnecessary management layers.
 Identify talent gaps and recommend additional resources when supported by clear financial opportunities.
 Develop systems and team capabilities that reduce dependence on the CEO for daily growth decisions.
 SYSTEMS, ANALYTICS & AI 
 Work with Analytics to maintain reliable marketing performance dashboards and growth scorecards.
 Ensure marketing and financial data is accurate, actionable, and consistently measured across channels.
 Use AI and automation to accelerate market research, competitive analysis, creative testing, reporting, and growth execution.
 Identify repetitive growth workflows that can be automated or delegated.
 Maintain documentation, SOPs, and historical experiment results so successful strategies can be repeated and improved.
 REPORTING & ACCOUNTABILITY 
 Weekly Growth Scorecard: Revenue, incremental contribution profit, MER, marketing spend, active experiments, emerging winners, underperforming initiatives, and recommended actions.
 Weekly Growth Meeting: Review performance with relevant specialists, resolve bottlenecks, assign priorities, and make decisions without requiring the CEO to lead the discussion.
 Monthly Growth Investment Review: Evaluate the growth portfolio, recommend budget reallocations, and identify opportunities to scale or discontinue.
 Quarterly Growth Strategy: Present the next quarter's growth priorities, investment recommendations, financial targets, and resource requirements.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Lennox and Addington County General Hospital Foundation
jobs.description:
Position Title: Executive Director
 Reports to: Board of Directors
 Position: Full-time, On-site, Permanent
 Location: Napanee, Ontario
 Salary: $120,000-$150,000/year, and four weeks’ vacation

 About LACGHF 
 Lennox and Addington County General Hospital Foundation plays a vital role in advancing healthcare across Lennox and Addington County. Through the generosity of donors, businesses, and community partners, the Foundation raises funds for essential medical equipment, technology, and healthcare priorities that help ensure patients and families can access quality care close to home.
 The Foundation supports Lennox and Addington County General Hospital (LACGH), a trusted community hospital in Napanee, Ontario. With recent investments in diagnostic imaging, including MRI services, and the addition of a 128-bed long-term care home, the Hospital continues to expand its services and strengthen its role in meeting the region's evolving healthcare needs.
 With a dedicated team, engaged Board of Directors, and strong community support, the Foundation has a history of successful fundraising campaigns and meaningful donor relationships. Building on this foundation, the Foundation has significant opportunities to expand major gifts, strengthen legacy giving, and engage new supporters across the broader region.
 The Role 
 The Foundation is seeking an experienced, relationship-driven Executive Director to lead its next chapter of growth. Reporting to the Board of Directors, the Executive Director will provide strategic, financial, and operational leadership while strengthening the Foundation's fundraising capacity, community presence, and partnership with the Hospital.
 A central priority will be advancing major gifts fundraising by creating a clear program framework, building relationships with prospective donors, expanding legacy giving, and developing a more structured approach to donor cultivation and stewardship. The Executive Director will work closely with Board members and hospital leadership to identify philanthropic opportunities and secure meaningful investments in local healthcare.
 Equally important will be leading a small, dedicated team with professionalism, collaboration, and care. The successful candidate will build on the Foundation's existing accomplishments, strengthen organizational processes, and foster a positive environment where staff feel supported and empowered.
 As a visible ambassador for the Foundation, the Executive Director will develop trusted relationships throughout Lennox and Addington County, expanding awareness, engaging new supporters, and helping ensure the Foundation remains a valued partner in the community's healthcare future.

 Impact Areas 
 Strategic Leadership & Organizational Growth 
 Work collaboratively with the Board to develop and implement strategic and operational priorities aligned with the Foundation's mission and the Hospital's evolving needs.
 Provide overall leadership for the Foundation's operations, financial management, policies, and organizational performance.
 Establish clear goals, performance measures, and reporting practices to support accountability and informed decision-making.
 Oversee budgets, financial planning, and resource allocation, ensuring responsible stewardship of charitable funds.
 Support effective governance, Board engagement, and organizational planning.
 Major Gifts & Philanthropic Development 
 Lead the Foundation's fundraising strategy, with a strong emphasis on expanding major gifts, individual philanthropy, and long-term revenue growth.
 Identify, cultivate, solicit, and steward prospective major donors, building meaningful relationships that result in significant philanthropic commitments.
 Strengthen planned and legacy giving opportunities, working with donors and professional advisors to encourage long-term support.
 Lead fundraising initiatives and future capital campaigns in collaboration with hospital leadership, Board members, and staff.
 Expand relationships with individuals, private foundations, businesses, and community organizations to diversify philanthropic revenue.
 Oversee donor stewardship, recognition, and engagement strategies to strengthen relationships and encourage continued giving.
 People Leadership & Organizational Culture 
 Lead, mentor, and support the Foundation's staff, fostering a collaborative, respectful, and accountable workplace.
 Establish clear roles, expectations, and performance management practices while supporting professional development.
 Guide organizational growth and change thoughtfully, recognizing existing strengths and preserving institutional knowledge.
 Promote open communication, teamwork, and a welcoming, donor-centred organizational culture.
 Build the Board’s fundraising knowledge and confidence through regular communication, collaboration, and training, equipping Board members with the tools and understanding needed to support donor engagement, philanthropic development, and the Foundation’s strategic priorities.
 Hospital Partnerships & Community Engagement 
 Develop strong, collaborative relationships with the Hospital's CEO, senior leadership, physicians, and other key stakeholders.
 Align philanthropic priorities with hospital equipment, infrastructure, and healthcare service needs.
 Serve as the public face of the Foundation, representing the organization at community events, donor meetings, presentations, and other public engagements.
 Build relationships with donors, businesses, service clubs, and community leaders throughout Lennox and Addington County.
 Expand the Foundation's visibility and engagement beyond Greater Napanee, strengthening connections throughout the broader hospital catchment area.
 Work collaboratively with hospital leadership to communicate the impact of philanthropy and identify opportunities for greater community support.

new_jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
new_jobs.description:
Partner with the CEO and Executive Team to define corporate strategy, establish growth priorities, and guide financial planning and capital allocation decisions.

 Lead board-level financial communications, including preparing financial presentations, developing performance narratives, and supporting board committees.

 Manage investor relations, including shareholder communications, investor updates, financial data rooms, and due diligence processes.

 Develop and oversee capital strategies, including fundraising initiatives, debt financing, and preparation for potential mergers and acquisitions.

 Build, lead, and develop the finance function, initially managing a direct report while identifying future organizational and resource requirements.

 Own the annual operating plan, workforce planning, long-range financial models, and revenue and bookings forecasts.

 Oversee revenue modelling, cash flow management, liquidity, runway planning, and financial scenario analysis.

 Establish and monitor SaaS financial performance metrics, including Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), gross and net revenue retention, churn, bookings, and pipeline-to-revenue conversion.

 Analyze unit economics, including Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), customer lifetime value (LTV), payback periods, and gross margins, using cohort, churn, and expansion insights to support strategic decisions.

 Deliver monthly financial and operational performance reports to the Leadership Team and comprehensive quarterly reporting to the board.

 Maintain robust internal financial controls, audit readiness, revenue recognition practices, and compliance with Canadian and US tax requirements.

 Define the organization's legal and contract strategy while managing external legal counsel, including service scope, relationships, and associated costs.

 Establish and oversee contractual frameworks covering Master Subscription Agreements, Order Forms, Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), and partner, reseller, integration, and vendor agreements.

 Review and manage complex contract negotiations, school district contract amendments, non-standard commercial terms, and RFP responses, exercising signing authority within board-approved limits.

 Serve as Corporate Secretary, overseeing board and shareholder resolutions, meeting minutes, corporate records, and governance documentation.

 Manage the capitalization table and equity programs, including stock option grants, vesting schedules, equity plan administration, and fair market value (FMV) and 409A valuations.

 Oversee legal disputes, demand letters, and litigation matters in collaboration with external counsel.

 Lead corporate insurance and risk management programs, including general liability, cyber liability, errors and omissions (E&O), directors and officers (D&O), and employment practices coverage.

 Manage insurance broker relationships, policy renewals, certificates of insurance, and claims.

 Collaborate with the CEO, Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), and sales leadership to develop pricing, packaging, and commercial strategies.

 Establish pricing governance frameworks, including discount approval processes, non-standard contract terms, and deal desk oversight for complex district and multi-year agreements.

 Design annual sales and customer experience compensation plans, quotas, and incentive documentation in collaboration with commercial leadership.

 Oversee monthly sales commission processes, including calculations, approvals, clawbacks, commission splits, special performance incentives (SPIFs), and dispute resolution.

 Requirements:

 CPA designation is mandatory.

 12+ years of professional experience in finance and accounting, including at least 5 years in a senior finance leadership position such as CFO, VP of Finance, or equivalent.

 Previous senior leadership experience within a SaaS business or high-growth technology company.

 Demonstrated experience reporting directly to a CEO and presenting financial strategies and performance results to a Board of Directors.

 Proven ability to develop and execute financial strategies, operating models, and scalable financial structures that support businesses through different stages of growth.

 Strong expertise in SaaS financial metrics, subscription revenue models, unit economics, and translating financial performance into meaningful insights for board members and investors.

 Experience managing investor relations, fundraising activities, capital strategy, and financial due diligence.

 Strong commercial and legal understanding, including contract negotiations, external legal counsel management, and corporate governance.

 In-depth knowledge of revenue recognition, internal financial controls, audit processes, and cross-border taxation involving Canada and the United States.

 Experience developing and managing sales compensation structures, commission plans, pricing frameworks, and discount governance.

 Excellent financial modelling, forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning capabilities.

 Experience managing corporate insurance, enterprise risk, equity programs, and capitalization tables is highly valuable.

 Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex financial and commercial matters clearly to boards, leadership teams, and operational employees.

 Proven leadership and team-building capabilities, with a focus on developing people, systems, and processes that support sustainable growth.

 Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance business opportunities with financial, contractual, and operational risk.

 A collaborative and relationship-oriented leadership style, combining accountability, empathy, adaptability, and sound decision-making.

 Experience in EdTech, K-12 education, public-sector organizations, or local government is considered a significant asset, particularly familiarity with school district procurement, RFP processes, and contractual requirements.

 Previous experience leading a company through fundraising, acquisitions, or post-acquisition integration is an advantage.

 Corporate Secretary responsibilities, equity plan administration, and capitalization table management experience are additional assets.

 Experience overseeing legal and insurance functions in an organization without in-house legal counsel is also beneficial.

 Benefits:

 Total On-Target Earnings (OTE): CAD $250,000–$320,000, including base salary and variable compensation.

 Remote working opportunity based in Canada.

 Executive-level position with direct reporting to the CEO and membership in the Executive Team.

 Significant influence over corporate strategy, financial planning, capital allocation, and organizational growth.

 Opportunity to build and develop the finance function and shape its long-term structure.

 Annual compensation reviews in November, considering market benchmarks and individual performance.

 Compensation philosophy focused on fairness, market alignment, and rewarding measurable impact.

 Access to a comprehensive benefits and perks package.

 Supportive and collaborative working culture that values autonomy, shared ownership, and professional development.

 Opportunity to contribute to a meaningful mission focused on improving the educational experience for students and educators.

 Collaborative team environment that encourages innovation, curiosity, and the responsible use of AI-powered tools to improve productivity.

Define the company's market point of view and own its brand narrative, voice, and editorial standards across external channels.

 Develop strategies to increase brand visibility and share of voice in conversations involving general partners (GPs), limited partners (LPs), and their professional advisors.

 Build a research and editorial program using proprietary platform data, industry benchmarks, and expert insights to produce reports, newsletters, recurring content series, and long-form thought leadership.

 Identify influential networks across GPs, LPs, fund counsel, auditors, placement agents, and fund administrators, and distribute relevant insights through these communities.

 Equip partnership and pipeline teams with research and messaging that support relationship-building and business development.

 Develop company executives and subject-matter experts into credible public voices through thought leadership, social content, and executive social programs, including ghostwriting when needed.

 Lead the corporate website's narrative, content strategy, and structure, ensuring it communicates a consistent market perspective and builds audience trust.

 Partner with product marketing to align product and asset-class pages with the broader brand narrative and positioning.

 Identify priority industry topics and lead SEO and content initiatives that build authority across traditional and AI-powered search.

 Recruit, manage, and develop content, web, and social teams, establishing editorial workflows, planning processes, quality standards, and performance measurement.

 Integrate practical AI tools into content operations to improve quality, efficiency, and scalability.

 Track and report performance indicators, including share of voice, branded search, audience growth, and engagement among target audiences.

 Requirements

 At least 8 years of experience in brand, editorial, or content leadership, including experience building and managing multidisciplinary teams.

 Demonstrated success establishing editorial authority for a B2B brand in a specialized, relationship-driven market.

 Experience developing contributor, community, or expert-voice programs that help a company's ideas spread through professional networks.

 A strong portfolio of editorial initiatives, such as research reports, long-form thought leadership, and executive content, supported by measurable results.

 Experience transforming proprietary data and research into valuable published insights that industry audiences rely on.

 Excellent writing and editing skills, with strong editorial judgment and the ability to identify ideas that resonate and generate discussion.

 Strong understanding of brand and content measurement, including share of voice, branded search, audience development, and engagement, with the ability to communicate results to executive stakeholders.

 Experience leading corporate website and SEO strategies.

 Ability to collaborate effectively with product marketing, revenue marketing, executives, and subject-matter experts.

 Practical experience applying AI tools to content workflows, including examples of tools configured or integrated into working processes.

 Strong strategic thinking, leadership, communication, and team-building skills.

 Familiarity with private markets, financial services, or fintech is an advantage, as is the willingness to develop deep knowledge of the sector.

 Benefits

 Base salary, performance bonus, and equity.

 Health, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families.

 Life insurance.

 Mental wellness coverage.

 Fertility and growing-family support.

 Flexible time off in addition to company-paid holidays.

 Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave.

 Retirement savings plans.

new_jobs.title: Practice Director, Microsoft Dynamics 365
new_jobs.description:
Define and execute the overall Dynamics 365 practice strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities, positioning Finance & Operations as the primary growth driver and Business Central as a complementary offering.

 Take full ownership of the practice's financial performance, including P&L management, revenue growth, profitability, margins, utilization, budgets, and forecasts.

 Develop and execute growth plans covering revenue targets, bookings, workforce capacity, hiring strategies, and investments required to scale the practice.

 Lead the expansion of Dynamics 365 services, particularly across Finance, Supply Chain Management, Commerce, and Project Operations, while establishing scalable delivery capabilities for Business Central.

 Drive business development and market expansion by generating new opportunities, strengthening existing client relationships, and increasing the pipeline for large-scale Dynamics 365 engagements.

 Develop and implement go-to-market strategies, including target industries, sales initiatives, commercial positioning, and pursuit strategies for both F&O and Business Central.

 Build and lead a dedicated sales and pre-sales organization, collaborating with Sales leadership to improve forecasting accuracy, acquisition performance, and deal conversion.

 Serve as executive sponsor for strategic opportunities, leading deal shaping, commercial negotiations, and high-value client engagements.

 Strengthen relationships with Microsoft, Dynamics 365 ISVs, partner organizations, and industry stakeholders to develop strategic alliances, co-selling initiatives, and joint go-to-market opportunities.

 Identify and develop industry-specific solutions, implementation accelerators, and managed services to expand the practice's service portfolio and market differentiation.

 Drive account expansion through upselling, cross-selling, and legacy ERP modernization and migration initiatives.

 Establish delivery governance frameworks, quality standards, risk management processes, and operational best practices across all Dynamics 365 engagements.

 Act as the senior escalation point for complex or critical projects, ensuring delivery excellence, effective change management, strong user adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

 Build, develop, and inspire a high-performing leadership team comprising Practice Leads, Solution Architects, Functional Consultants, and Delivery Leaders.

 Oversee talent acquisition, succession planning, professional development, Microsoft certifications, and employee retention initiatives.

 Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and client-focused execution.

 Collaborate with Cloud, Data & AI, Integration, and Managed Services leadership to deliver comprehensive, integrated enterprise solutions.

 Represent the Dynamics 365 practice at executive level with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders, contributing to broader corporate strategy, growth initiatives, and potential M&A integration activities.

 Requirements:

 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

 At least 10 years of experience in ERP consulting or enterprise applications, including significant experience in senior leadership positions.

 Extensive expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, particularly Finance and Supply Chain Management, with working knowledge of Dynamics 365 Business Central.

 Strong background in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), accounting, and program management, combined with hands-on experience advising customers on business planning and finance transformation.

 Demonstrated success building, scaling, and managing Dynamics 365 practices, including responsibility for business growth, pipeline generation, new client acquisition, and revenue and margin performance.

 Proven experience leading complex, large-scale Dynamics 365 implementations and enterprise transformation programs.

 Strong financial and commercial acumen, with experience managing P&L, budgets, forecasts, profitability, and business performance.

 Established relationships with Microsoft account teams and partner organizations, with practical experience in co-selling initiatives, strategic alliances, and Microsoft partner programs.

 Familiarity with Dynamics 365 licensing models, product roadmaps, release cycles, industry solutions, and the broader Microsoft partner ecosystem.

 Microsoft Dynamics 365 certifications, particularly in Finance or Supply Chain Management, are considered an asset.

 Experience building and managing large, geographically distributed consulting and delivery organizations.

 Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence C-suite stakeholders, senior clients, technology partners, and internal leadership teams.

 Excellent strategic thinking and business development capabilities, with the ability to translate long-term objectives into actionable growth initiatives.

 Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, including the ability to inspire teams, build relationships, manage change, and create alignment across business functions.

 Decisive, accountable, and comfortable navigating complex decisions and fast-paced, high-growth environments.

 A client-centric mindset, with a strong commitment to delivering measurable business outcomes and long-term customer value.

 Entrepreneurial and growth-oriented approach, with enthusiasm for building teams, scaling technology practices, and driving continuous innovation.

 Benefits:

 Fully remote working arrangement within Canada.

 Senior executive leadership opportunity with ownership of a strategic and growing Microsoft Dynamics 365 practice.

 Opportunity to shape business strategy, influence market positioning, and drive significant revenue and organizational growth.

 Exposure to enterprise-scale digital transformation initiatives and complex Dynamics 365 F&O and Business Central implementations.

 Opportunity to develop strategic relationships with Microsoft, technology partners, and major enterprise clients.

 Leadership role with the ability to build and develop high-performing teams and influence long-term organizational direction.

 Opportunity to collaborate across Cloud, Data & AI, Integration, and Managed Services practices.

 Professional growth through exposure to emerging Microsoft technologies, strategic partnerships, and enterprise transformation programs.

new_jobs.title: VP of Finance
new_jobs.description:
Lead financial strategy, planning, budgeting, forecasting, and monthly reporting, ensuring alignment between financial performance, revenue projections, and business objectives. 

 Develop and maintain the annual operating plan, headcount plan, revenue models, cash forecasts, and financial scenario analyses. 

 Oversee financial controls, compliance, revenue recognition, and cross-border tax readiness across Canada and the United States. 

 Establish and maintain reliable SaaS performance metrics, including ARR, gross and net revenue retention, churn, bookings, and pipeline-to-revenue conversion. 

 Monitor unit economics, including customer acquisition costs (CAC), payback periods, lifetime value (LTV), and gross margins, providing insights through cohort, churn, and expansion analyses. 

 Prepare monthly financial and performance reports for the Leadership Team, as well as board presentations and investor updates. 

 Support investor relations through shareholder communications, investor requests, and maintaining due diligence documentation and data rooms. 

 Lead commercial contract management, including subscription agreements, order forms, data processing agreements, partner agreements, reseller contracts, vendor agreements, and NDAs. 

 Oversee contract negotiations, school district redlines, non-standard terms, and RFP contract responses while managing external legal counsel and related expenses. 

 Manage corporate governance responsibilities, including board and shareholder resolutions, corporate records, minute books, and corporate secretary duties. 

 Oversee equity administration, including capitalization tables, stock option plans, equity grants, vesting records, and fair market value valuations. 

 Lead the corporate insurance and risk management program, including general liability, cyber, errors and omissions, directors and officers, and employment practices coverage. 

 Manage insurance renewals, broker relationships, certificates of insurance, additional-insured requests, and claims. 

 Partner with Sales and Customer Success leadership to develop compensation plans, establish quotas, and administer sales incentive programs. 

 Oversee monthly commission calculations, approvals, payroll handoffs, clawbacks, commission splits, SPIFs, and dispute resolution. 

 Establish pricing governance policies, discount approval frameworks, and deal desk processes to support complex customer agreements and multi-year contracts. 

 Lead and mentor a finance team of two direct reports, while developing the systems, processes, and capabilities needed to support future growth. 

 Requirements: 

 CPA designation is required. 

 At least 8 years of experience in finance and accounting, including 4 or more years in a financial leadership position. 

 Proven financial leadership experience within a scaling SaaS, technology, or high-growth organization. 

 Strong expertise in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), including financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting. 

 In-depth understanding of SaaS financial metrics and their relationship to business performance, profitability, and board-level reporting. 

 Experience with revenue recognition, internal financial controls, regulatory compliance, and cross-border taxation. 

 Practical experience managing commercial contracts, negotiating contractual terms, reviewing redlines, and coordinating external legal counsel. 

 Experience designing, implementing, or administering sales compensation and commission programs. 

 Familiarity with financial management systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, or equivalent platforms. 

 Advanced spreadsheet and financial modelling skills, with a strong focus on data accuracy and reporting reliability. 

 Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex financial information to executives, board members, sales teams, and non-financial stakeholders. 

 Strong leadership, organizational, and relationship-building abilities, combined with sound commercial judgment and problem-solving skills. 

 Ability to build scalable processes, balance business priorities with risk management, and operate effectively in a fast-growing environment. 

 Nice-to-have qualifications: 

 Experience in EdTech, K-12 education, public sector, or local government, particularly with district procurement, RFPs, and contractual requirements. 

 Experience as a corporate secretary or managing capitalization tables and equity incentive programs. 

 Exposure to mergers and acquisitions, including due diligence, transaction preparation, or post-acquisition integration. 

 Previous responsibility for corporate insurance programs and enterprise risk management. 

 Benefits: 

 Competitive total on-target earnings (OTE) ranging from CAD 200,000 to CAD 250,000, combining base salary and variable compensation. 

 Remote working opportunity based in Kelowna, British Columbia, with a collaborative and supportive team environment. 

 Leadership autonomy and the opportunity to shape financial strategy, commercial operations, and organizational growth. 

 Opportunity to build and develop a finance function, lead a team, and implement scalable business processes. 

 Annual compensation reviews conducted in November, taking into account market benchmarks and individual performance. 

 Compensation philosophy focused on fairness, transparency, market alignment, and opportunities for professional growth. 

 Opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven technology business supporting educators and students. 

 Collaborative culture that values shared ownership, continuous learning, accountability, empathy, and individual contributions.

new_jobs.title: VP, Consulting & Transformation
new_jobs.description:
Consulting and Transformation Leadership

 Lead senior client engagements across digital and AI transformation, platform selection and replatforming, international expansion, B2B commerce, retail and point of sale (POS), loyalty, marketplaces, data, and operating models.

 Facilitate structured discovery across business objectives, customer insights, data, technology, organizational capabilities, and operating models.

 Translate complex or ambiguous client needs into clear goals, identified gaps, prioritized initiatives, and practical transformation plans.

 Develop compelling business cases that connect strategic roadmaps to funded initiatives, prioritizing opportunities based on business impact, customer value, effort, and dependencies.

 Create multi-year transformation roadmaps that define the desired future state and the steps required to achieve it.

 Provide independent recommendations on the best path forward for clients, including partner or co-delivery models when their needs extend beyond internal delivery capabilities.

 Client Retention, Account Expansion, and Commercial Growth

 Own long-term strategic plans for top-tier retained clients, aligned with their one-, three-, and five-year business objectives.

 Lead or co-lead Growth Councils and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) alongside Client Partners, focusing on future opportunities, measurable return on investment, and business outcomes.

 Bring together strategy, AI and transformation, CRM and lifecycle, conversion optimization, SEO/GEO/AEO, design, and technology perspectives into a unified client growth strategy.

 Help evolve client relationships from individual project delivery into broader, multi-service partnerships.

 Contribute strategic judgment to client health assessments and monthly intelligence reporting, complementing AI-generated analysis.

 Ensure consulting services are clearly scoped, priced, and incorporated into retainers and new engagements.

 Support strategic sales opportunities by bringing senior-level transformation expertise into client conversations and pitches.

 Shape the scope and strategic approach of complex, multidisciplinary proposals before pricing, ensuring recommendations are differentiated and outcome-oriented.

 Own and continuously refine the strategic positioning and pitch narrative, presenting the business as a comprehensive digital services and transformation partner rather than solely a platform implementation provider.

 Practice Leadership and Commercial Performance

 Lead and develop a multidisciplinary consulting practice covering strategy, conversion rate optimization, CRM and lifecycle, SEO/GEO/AEO, and emerging AI services.

 Maintain a strong understanding of each discipline, including its core performance indicators, methodologies, and applications across project-based and retained engagements.

 Own practice quality, methodologies, playbooks, team structure, performance management, and day-to-day operations.

 Carry responsibility for practice margin and utilization targets.

 Build scalable documentation, frameworks, and evaluation criteria that enable each discipline to grow beyond the capabilities of individual contributors.

 Turn successful pilots, managed services, and AI commerce capabilities into repeatable offerings with clearly defined scope and pricing.

 Shape the practice's perspective on the broader digital commerce ecosystem, including search and discovery, personalization, lifecycle messaging, loyalty, subscriptions, PIM, ERP, OMS, DAM, data, and AI tools.

 Advise clients on whether their existing technology stack supports their growth ambitions and competitive requirements, and identify where investment or reinvention is needed.

 AI Transformation and People Leadership

 Champion the practical application of AI in client transformation roadmaps, connecting emerging capabilities to measurable business value.

 Bring AI-enabled capabilities into sales and advisory conversations, including AI discoverability, agentic commerce operations, and technology partner stack advisory.

 Redesign consulting methodologies and discipline deliverables for AI-native workflows, with a focus on measurable improvements.

 Mentor and develop discipline leaders, building trust while encouraging continuous improvement, stronger performance, and revenue growth.

 Establish clear performance standards and develop a leadership bench capable of operating independently and delivering results.

 Hold direct reports and practice leaders accountable for outcomes, ownership, and execution.

 Requirements:

 At least 10 years of experience in consulting, strategy, or senior client leadership, including substantial experience in a senior client-facing role at an agency, digital consultancy, or consulting firm.

 Proven track record leading digital transformation engagements from ambiguous business challenges through funded roadmaps and successful delivery.

 Experience leading a consulting or strategy function and managing a multidisciplinary team or practice.

 Demonstrated ability to define consulting offerings, establish methodologies, manage commercial performance, and build and develop leadership teams.

 Strong experience developing and defending business cases for digital transformation initiatives, including ROI modeling and prioritization frameworks.

 Proven success growing retained or recurring revenue relationships, beyond acquiring new business.

 Strong understanding of digital commerce growth drivers, including demand generation, conversion, customer lifecycle and retention, merchandising, average order value (AOV), and the data connecting these areas.

 Ability to provide credible strategic recommendations across multiple disciplines while effectively guiding specialist leaders.

 Deep familiarity with the digital commerce ecosystem, including platforms, partner networks, applications, and enterprise systems.

 Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect strategic recommendations to client value, investment requirements, and expected returns.

 Excellent executive communication, relationship management, leadership, and stakeholder engagement skills.

 Ability to balance strategic vision with hands-on execution, team development, and accountability for business outcomes.

 Benefits:

 Competitive healthcare coverage, including dental and vision insurance.

 Retirement savings plan with employer matching.

 Competitive paid time off (PTO) policy, including paid time off at the end of the year.

 Flexible working schedule.

 Remote-first work culture.

 Home office stipend.

 Apple equipment.

 Continued education and professional development opportunities.

new_jobs.title: AVP, Global Technology and Solutions, Strategy and Insights
new_jobs.description:
Work Location: 
Toronto, Ontario, Canada 
 Hours: 
37.5 
 Line of Business: 
Business Management, Strategy & Support 
 Pay Details: 
$160,000 - $200,000 CAD 

This role is eligible for a discretionary variable compensation award that considers business and individual performance. 
 TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

 As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

 Job Description: 
 Department Overview

 Global Technology & Solutions (GTS) enables the Bank’s strategy by delivering enterprise technology that supports clients and colleagues, protecting TD through strong fraud, cyber, technology, and physical security controls, enabling agility in response to evolving client needs and market dynamics, and supporting the delivery and execution of work across the organization. GTS is central to how TD modernizes, innovates, manages risk, and delivers secure, reliable, and differentiated experiences.

 Team Overview

 The GTS Strategy and Insights team helps shape where GTS goes next—and how we tell that story. We support GTS’ most senior technology leader and leadership team by developing fact-based analysis, executive-ready narratives, presentations, memos, and insights that help drive alignment and support decision-making for audiences including the Chief Executive Officer, the Senior Executive Leadership team, and the Board of Directors.

 The AVP - GTS Strategy and Insights will lead a team responsible for executive deliverables, strategic planning, enterprise and industry research, executive communications, and performance reporting against GTS priorities. The team sits same organization as Change Management, Communications, and Colleague Engagement, creating strong alignment between strategy, messaging, adoption, and colleague experience to ensure priorities are translated into clear narratives, practical change plans, and measurable business outcomes.

 Job Description

 Reporting to the Head, Strategy and Insights, Product Owner & Analyst Practices the successful candidate will lead the GTS Strategy function and will be accountable for influencing and shaping Senior Executive and Board-level content while overseeing the team’s day-to-day operations and delivery of high-quality analysis, insights, and strategic materials.
 This role is ideal for someone who can operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, and communication—understanding complex technology and business issues, identifying what matters, and translating that thinking into clear recommendations and executive-ready narratives.

 Key accountabilities include: 

 Lead all strategy-related deliverables required through enterprise processes or as directed by ESVP Global Technology and Solutions, ensuring each is grounded in evidence, aligned to GTS priorities, and positioned to support executive decisions.
 Lead the development, planning and communication of strategic narratives, insights, and recommendations that influence Executive and Board discussions, build alignment, and advance GTS' strategic priorities (e.g., Executive level presentations, memos, briefings and other materials for GTS Senior Leadership, Board, and/or Governance forums).
 Set the standard for clear, fact-based, outcome-oriented materials that simplify complex technology, workforce, financial, cyber, data, artificial intelligence, delivery, and regulatory topics for senior executive audiences.
 Responsible for leading the development and refresh of GTS’ short, medium, and long-term strategy, and priorities, translating strategic direction into actionable focus areas, investment ideas, and measurable outcomes.
 Develop insights on strategic issues facing GTS, including technology modernization, software delivery, artificial intelligence adoption, workforce transformation, productivity, cyber resilience, data and cloud, cost management, and regulatory priorities.
 Serve as GTS’ technology research lead by continuously drawing on external sources, including articles, books, podcasts, research, industry forums, and expert perspectives—to proactively identify leading-edge insights from across the technology and financial services landscape, raise critical awareness, and translate relevant insights into strategic deliverables, team priorities, and investment choices.
 Own performance reporting and executive insights for GTS priorities, ensuring timely, accurate, and data-driven assessment of strategic, transformation, financial, workforce, and operational outcomes to support informed decision-making and accountability.
 Drive alignment on GTS strategic priorities by influencing senior stakeholders, resolving cross-functional dependencies, surfacing risks and opportunities, and providing actionable recommendations that support executive decisions and drive measurable business outcomes.
 Lead the Strategy & Insights function, establishing priorities, allocating resources, managing strategic risks and dependencies, and ensuring successful delivery of key commitments.
 Lead, coach, and develop a high performing of team of strategy and insight specialists while fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture.

 Job Requirements

 Required: 

 Demonstrated ability to influence Senior Executives and support complex strategic decisions.
 Experience translating industry trends and external research into strategic recommendations and business outcomes for SVP+ level audiences.
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.
 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including development of executive and Board-level materials.
 Strong business acumen and understanding of technology's role in driving enterprise outcomes.
 Proven ability to synthesize complex technical, financial, and strategic information into clear, compelling messages for senior executive and Board level audiences.
 Strong understanding of technology transformation, software delivery, artificial intelligence-enabled ways of working, data, cyber, cloud, infrastructure, digital tools, and the role of technology in enabling business strategy.
 Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, workback plans, and senior stakeholder expectations in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.
 Exceptional relationship-building, collaboration, and influencing skills, with a proven ability to align diverse stakeholders, build trusted partnerships, and drive outcomes across functions and leadership levels. Strong business acumen, with the ability to connect technology priorities to enterprise strategy, customer outcomes, colleague outcomes, risk, and financial performance.
 Experience leading teams and building high-performing, inclusive cultures.

 Preferred: 

 Experience in software engineering, technology delivery, technology strategy, architecture, product, data, cyber, or a related discipline.
 Consulting experience, particularly in strategic messaging, executive communications, technology strategy, or enterprise transformation.
 Experience supporting the Chief Executive Officer, senior executive leadership team, Board of Directors, or equivalent senior governance forums.
 Demonstrated strategic curiosity and insight, leveraging external trends, competitive intelligence, and emerging technologies to challenge thinking, shape priorities and inform GTS strategy and decision-making.
 Proven experience translating market, competitive, and technology insights into strategic recommendations that inform investment decisions, transformation priorities, and operating model evolution.

 Additional Information

 This role offers the opportunity to work directly on the strategic agenda for a large, complex technology organization; influence executive and Board-level materials; lead a small, high-performing team; and help GTS make clearer choices about where to focus time, talent, and resources.

 Who We Are: 
 TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities. 

 Our Total Rewards Package 
Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more 

 Additional Information: 
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

 Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

 Colleague Development 
 If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

 If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.  

 We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

 Training & Onboarding 
We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

 Interview Process  
We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

 Accommodation 
Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Sans Objet
